title.zh: 卷六 本紀第六: 世祖三
title.raw: 卷六 本紀第六: 世祖三 Volume 6 Annals 6: Shizu 3

sentences.zh: 二年春正月辛未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on xinwei new moon day, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on the xinwei new moon of the first month of spring, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，山東廉訪使言：「真定路總管張宏，前在濟南，乘變盜用官物。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, the Shandong surveillance commissioner reported: "Zhang Hong, chief commissioner of Zhending Circuit, formerly in Jinan, took advantage of the disturbance to embezzle government goods.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Shandong surveillance commissioner reported that Zhang Hong, chief commissioner of Zhending Circuit, had embezzled government property while stationed in Jinan during the upheaval.

sentences.zh: 」詔以宏嘗告李亶反，免宏死罪，罷其職，征贓物償官。

translations.literal: " An edict noted that Hong had once reported Li Tan's rebellion, pardoned him from the death penalty, removed him from office, and ordered confiscation of the stolen goods for repayment to the government.
translations.idiomatic: An edict noted that Hong had once reported Li Tan's rebellion, spared him the death penalty, dismissed him from office, and ordered the stolen goods seized and returned to the treasury.

sentences.zh: 邳州萬戶張邦直等違制販馬，並處死。

translations.literal: Zhang Bangzhi, wanhu of Pizhou, and others sold horses in violation of regulations; all were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Bangzhi, wanhu of Pizhou, and others traded horses in defiance of the ban; all were put to death.

sentences.zh: 敕徙鎮海、百八里、謙謙州諸色匠戶於中都，給銀萬五千兩為行費。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the relocation to Zhongdu of artisans of all categories from Zhenhai, Baibalixian, and Qianqianzhou, providing fifteen thousand taels of silver as travel expenses.
translations.idiomatic: An edict moved artisans of every trade from Zhenhai, Baibalixian, and Qianqianzhou to Zhongdu and granted them fifteen thousand taels of silver for travel.

sentences.zh: 又徙奴懷、忒木帶兒炮手人匠八百名赴中都，造船運糧。

translations.literal: Eight hundred catapult artificers and craftsmen from Nu Huai and Temudai'er were also relocated to Zhongdu to build ships and transport grain.
translations.idiomatic: Eight hundred catapult crews and craftsmen under Nu Huai and Temudai'er were also sent to Zhongdu to build ships and haul grain.

sentences.zh: 己卯，北京路行省給劄剌赤戶東徙行糧萬石。

translations.literal: On jimao day, the Beijing Circuit Branch Secretariat supplied ten thousand shi of travel grain to Jalichi households relocating eastward.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day the Beijing branch secretariat issued ten thousand shi of travel grain to Jalichi households moving east.

sentences.zh: 以鄧州監戰訥懷、新舊軍萬戶董文炳並為河南副統軍。

translations.literal: Ne Huai, battle overseer of Dengzhou, and Dong Wenbing, wanhu of new and old armies, were both appointed deputy commanders-in-chief of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Ne Huai, battle overseer at Dengzhou, and Dong Wenbing, wanhu of the new and old armies, were both made deputy commanders-in-chief of Henan.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔申嚴越界販馬之禁，違者處死。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, an edict strictly reinforced the prohibition on cross-border horse trading; violators were to be executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the Emperor strictly reinforced the ban on cross-border horse trading; violators would be executed.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以河南北荒田分給蒙古軍耕種。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, wasteland in northern Henan was distributed among Mongol troops for cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day wasteland in northern Henan was allotted to Mongol soldiers for farming.

sentences.zh: 戊子，諸王塔察兒使臣闊闊出至北京花道驛，手殺驛吏郝用、郭和尚，有旨征鈔十錠給其主贖死。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Kokuochu, envoy of Prince Tachar, reached Huadao Post on the Beijing route and personally killed post clerks Hao Yong and Guo Heshang. An imperial order levied ten ingots of paper money from his master to redeem him from death.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Kokuochu, envoy of Prince Tachar, reached Huadao Post on the Beijing route and killed the clerks Hao Yong and Guo Heshang with his own hand. The Emperor ordered his master to pay ten ingots of paper money to redeem him from death.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，城西番匣答路。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, the western city wall was extended to Xiada Road.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the western city wall was extended as far as Xiada Road.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，八東乞兒部牙西來朝，貢銀鼠皮二千，賜金、素幣各九、帛十有八。

translations.literal: On guisi day, Buya of the Badongqir tribe came to court, presenting two thousand silver-fox pelts. He was granted nine of each of gold and plain silks, and eighteen bolts of brocade.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Buya of the Badongqir tribe came to court with two thousand silver-fox pelts. He received nine pieces each of gold and plain silk and eighteen bolts of brocade.

sentences.zh: 武城縣王氏妻崔一產三男。

translations.literal: In Wucheng County, Lady Cui, wife of the Wang family, gave birth to three sons in one delivery.
translations.idiomatic: In Wucheng County Lady Cui of the Wang clan gave birth to triplets.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，給親王玉龍答失部民糧二千石。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, two thousand shi of grain were allotted to the people under Prince Yulongdash.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day two thousand shi of grain were granted to the people under Prince Yulongdash.

sentences.zh: 高麗國王王禃遣其弟廣平公恂奉表來貢。

translations.literal: King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent his younger brother, Prince Guangping Shun, bearing a memorial as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent his younger brother Prince Guangping Shun with a memorial and tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑朔，元帥按東與宋兵戰於釣魚山，敗之，獲戰艦百四十六艘。

translations.literal: Second month, xinchou new moon: Commander Andong fought Song troops at Diaoyu Mountain, defeated them, and captured one hundred forty-six warships.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou new moon of the second month Commander Andong fought the Song at Diaoyu Mountain, routed them, and took one hundred forty-six warships.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，初立宮闈局。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, the Inner Palace Bureau was first established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Inner Palace Bureau was established for the first time.

sentences.zh: 戊申，賜親王兀魯帶河間王印，給所部米千石。

translations.literal: On wushen day, Prince Uludai was granted the seal of Prince of Hejian and given one thousand shi of rice for his people.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Prince Uludai received the seal of Prince of Hejian and one thousand shi of rice for his followers.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，車駕幸上都。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, the imperial carriage visited Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the Emperor traveled to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，並六部為四，以麥術丁為吏禮部尚書，馬亨戶部尚書，嚴忠範兵刑部尚書，別魯丁工部尚書。

translations.literal: On guihai day, the six ministries were consolidated into four. Maimutding was made Minister of the combined Personnel and Rites Ministry, Ma Heng Minister of Revenue, Yan Zhongfan Minister of War and Justice, and Bieluding Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the six ministries were merged into four: Maimutding became minister of personnel and rites, Ma Heng of revenue, Yan Zhongfan of war and justice, and Bieluding of works.

sentences.zh: 禁山東東路私煎硝堿。

translations.literal: Private brewing of saltpeter was forbidden in Shandong East Route.
translations.idiomatic: Private distillation of saltpeter was banned in Shandong East Route.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以蒙古人充各路達魯花赤，漢人充總管，回回人充同知，永為定制。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, Mongols were appointed darughachi for all circuits, Han Chinese as chief commissioners, and Muslims as deputy commissioners — this was made permanent policy.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Mongols were made darughachi in every circuit, Han Chinese chief commissioners, and Muslims deputy commissioners — a permanent arrangement.

sentences.zh: 以同知東平路宣慰使寶合丁為平章政事，山東廉訪使王晉為參知政事。

translations.literal: Baoheding, deputy commissioner of the Dongping Circuit Pacification Commission, was made Grand Councillor; Wang Jin, Shandong surveillance commissioner, was made Associate Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Baoheding, deputy commissioner of the Dongping pacification commission, was appointed grand councillor, and Wang Jin, Shandong surveillance commissioner, associate councillor.

sentences.zh: 廉希憲、商挺罷。

translations.literal: Lian Xixian and Shang Ting were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Lian Xixian and Shang Ting were removed from office.

sentences.zh: 詔並諸王只必帖木兒所設管民官屬。

translations.literal: An edict merged the civilian administration officers established by Prince Jibtemur.
translations.idiomatic: An edict consolidated the civilian officials Prince Jibtemur had set up.

sentences.zh: 詔諭總統所：「僧人通五大部經者為中選，以有德業者為州郡僧錄、判、正副都綱等官，仍於各路設三學講、三禪會。」

translations.literal: An edict addressed the Patriarchate: "Monks who have mastered the Five Great Canon divisions shall be selected as finalists; those of moral standing shall be appointed state and prefectural Buddhist recorders, judges, chief and deputy abbots, and other posts. Three Doctrine Lecture halls and Three Chan assemblies shall still be established in each route."
translations.idiomatic: An edict to the Buddhist patriarchate declared that monks who had mastered the Five Great Canon divisions would be chosen as finalists, and men of virtue would be appointed state and prefectural recorders, judges, chief and deputy abbots, and the like. Each route was still to maintain Three Doctrine Lecture halls and Three Chan assemblies.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉，骨嵬國人襲殺吉裏迷部兵，敕以官粟及弓甲給之。

translations.literal: Third month, guiyou day: Guriyeo people raided and killed Kirimi troops. An edict ordered official grain, bows, and armor supplied to them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guiyou day, Guriyeo raiders killed Kirimi soldiers. An edict ordered government grain, bows, and armor issued to the victims.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，敕邊軍習水戰、屯田。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, an edict ordered frontier troops to train in naval warfare and garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day an edict told frontier troops to drill in naval combat and garrison farming.

sentences.zh: 誅宋諜李富住。

translations.literal: The Song spy Li Fuzhu was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fuzhu, a Song spy, was put to death.

sentences.zh: 乙未，罷南北互市，括民間南貨，官給其直。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, the north-south mutual market was abolished, southern goods among the populace were requisitioned, and the government paid their value.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day the north-south border market was closed, southern goods held by private households were seized, and the government paid fair value.

sentences.zh: 遼東饑，發粟萬石、鈔百錠賑之。

translations.literal: Eastern Liaoning suffered famine; ten thousand shi of grain and one hundred ingots of paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Liaoning was starving; the court issued ten thousand shi of grain and one hundred ingots of paper money for relief.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊午，賜諸王合必赤、亦怯烈金、素幣各四，拜行金幣一。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, wuwu day: Princes Hebichi and Eqilejin were each granted four plain silks and one gold piece for bowing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wuwu day, Princes Hebichi and Eqilejin each received four bolts of plain silk and one gold piece for the bowing ceremony.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，賞萬戶晃裏答兒所部征吐蕃功銀四百五十兩。

translations.literal: Fifth month, renwu day: Four hundred fifty taels of silver were awarded for the campaign against Tibet by the troops under Wanhu Hulida'er.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renwu day, four hundred fifty taels of silver were granted for the Tibetan campaign fought by Wanhu Hulida'er's troops.

sentences.zh: 戊子，禁北京、平灤等處人捕獵。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, hunting by local people was forbidden in Beijing, Pingluan, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day hunting by local residents was banned in Beijing, Pingluan, and neighboring districts.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，令：「軍中犯法，不得擅自誅戮，罪輕斷遣，重者聞奏。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, an order stated: "When soldiers violate the law in camp, they must not be executed on authority; lesser offenses are to be punished and sent away, graver ones reported to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day an order declared that soldiers who broke the law in camp could not be put to death on local authority: lighter crimes were to be punished and dismissed, heavier ones reported to the throne.

sentences.zh: 」敕上都商稅、酒醋諸課毋征，其榷鹽仍舊；

translations.literal: " An edict exempted Shangdu from commercial taxes, liquor taxes, and other levies; the salt monopoly remained unchanged;
translations.idiomatic: An edict exempted Shangdu from commercial taxes, liquor taxes, and similar dues, while the salt monopoly stayed as before;

sentences.zh: 諸人自願徙居永業者，復其家。

translations.literal: those who voluntarily moved to permanent homes had their households restored.
translations.idiomatic: and anyone who voluntarily settled on permanent land had household obligations waived.

sentences.zh: 詔西川、山東、南京等路戍邊軍屯田。

translations.literal: An edict ordered garrison frontier troops in West Sichuan, Shandong, Nanjing, and other circuits to garrison-farm.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered frontier garrisons in West Sichuan, Shandong, Nanjing, and other circuits to take up garrison farming.

sentences.zh: 閏五月癸卯，升蓚縣為景州。

translations.literal: Intercalary fifth month, guimao day: Gaoxian was promoted to Jing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month, on guimao day, Gaoxian was elevated to Jing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，檢核諸王兀魯帶部民貧無孳畜者三萬七百二十四人，人月給米二斗五升，四閱月而止。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, thirty thousand seven hundred twenty-four impoverished people without livestock among the followers of Prince Uludai were inspected; each person was given two dou five sheng of rice per month for four months.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day a review found thirty thousand seven hundred twenty-four poor followers of Prince Uludai without livestock; each received two dou five sheng of rice monthly for four months.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，雅州碉門宣撫使請復碉門城邑，詔相度之。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, the Diaomen Pacification Commissioner of Yazhou requested restoration of Diaomen city and towns; an edict ordered a survey.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the Diaomen pacification commissioner of Yazhou asked to rebuild Diaomen city and its towns; the Emperor ordered a survey.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，移秦蜀行省於興元。

translations.literal: On guihai day, the Qin-Shu Branch Secretariat was moved to Xingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the Qin-Shu branch secretariat was relocated to Xingyuan.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，命四川行院分兵屯田。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, the Sichuan Branch Secretariat was ordered to divide troops for garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Sichuan branch secretariat was told to detach troops for garrison farming.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，分四親王南京屬州，鄭州隸合丹，鈞州隸明裏，睢州隸孛羅赤，蔡州隸海都，他屬縣復還朝廷。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, the subordinate prefectures of the four princes in Nanjing were divided: Zheng Prefecture was placed under Hethan, Jun Prefecture under Mingli, Sui Prefecture under Boluochi, and Cai Prefecture under Haidu; other subordinate counties were returned to the court.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Nanjing prefectures held by four princes were reassigned: Zheng went to Hethan, Jun to Mingli, Sui to Boluochi, and Cai to Haidu; the remaining counties reverted to direct court control.

sentences.zh: 以平章政事趙璧行省於南京、河南府、大名、順德、洺磁、彰德、懷孟等路，平章政事廉希憲行省事於東平、濟南、益都、淄萊等路，中書左丞姚樞行省事於西京、平陽、太原等路。

translations.literal: Grand Councillor Zhao Bi was sent to administer branch secretariat affairs in Nanjing, Henan Prefecture, Daming, Shunde, Luoci, Zhangde, Huaimeng, and other circuits; Grand Councillor Lian Xixian to administer branch affairs in Dongping, Jinan, Yidu, Zilai, and other circuits; and Left Associate of the Central Secretariat Yao Shu to administer branch affairs in Xijing, Pingyang, Taiyuan, and other circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Councillor Zhao Bi was sent to run branch affairs in Nanjing, Henan Prefecture, Daming, Shunde, Luoci, Zhangde, Huaimeng, and neighboring circuits; Grand Councillor Lian Xixian in Dongping, Jinan, Yidu, Zilai, and the like; and Left Associate Yao Shu in Xijing, Pingyang, Taiyuan, and neighboring circuits.

sentences.zh: 詔：「諸路州府，若自古名郡，戶數繁庶，且當沖要者，不須改並。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "In the prefectures and districts of all circuits, if they are ancient famous commanderies, have numerous households, and stand at vital points, they need not be merged or abolished.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared that prefectures and districts on every circuit that were ancient famous commanderies, densely populated, and strategically placed should not be merged or abolished.

sentences.zh: 其戶不滿千者，可並則並之，各投下者，並入所隸州城。

translations.literal: Those with fewer than one thousand households may be merged where merger is possible; each appanage shall be merged into the prefectural city to which it belongs.
translations.idiomatic: Districts with fewer than one thousand households might be merged where feasible; each appanage was to be folded into its governing prefectural city.

sentences.zh: 其散府州郡戶少者，不須更設錄事司及司候司，附郭縣止令州府官兼領。

translations.literal: Scattered prefectures, districts, and commanderies with few households need not maintain separate record offices or gatekeeper offices; the prefectural and district officials shall concurrently administer the attached counties.
translations.idiomatic: Scattered prefectures and districts with small populations need not keep separate record offices or gatekeeper offices; prefectural officials would directly oversee the attached counties.

sentences.zh: 括諸路未占籍戶任差職者以聞。」

translations.literal: Households not yet registered on all circuits who hold corvée posts are to be reported."
translations.idiomatic: Unregistered households on every circuit who held corvée posts were to be reported to the throne."

sentences.zh: 六月戊辰朔，新得州安撫向良言：「頃以全城內附，元領軍民流散南界者，多欲歸順，並乞招徠。

translations.literal: Sixth month, wuchen new moon: Xinde Prefecture Pacification Commissioner Xiang Liang said: "When the whole city submitted inward, many soldiers and civilians who had scattered into the southern territories wished to return and submit; all beg to be summoned back.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen new moon of the sixth month Xiang Liang, pacification commissioner of Xinde Prefecture, reported that when the city had surrendered intact many soldiers and civilians who had fled south wished to return and submit, and asked that they be summoned back.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 又敕良以所領新降軍民移戍通江縣，行新得州事。

translations.literal: Liang was also ordered to move the newly surrendered soldiers and civilians he commanded to garrison Tongjiang County and administer Xinde Prefecture affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Liang was also ordered to move his newly surrendered soldiers and civilians to garrison Tongjiang County and administer Xinde Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛未，賜阿術所部馬價鈔一千二十三錠有奇。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, Aju's troops were granted one thousand twenty-three plus ingots of paper money for horse prices.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Aju's command received slightly more than one thousand twenty-three ingots of paper money to cover horse prices.

sentences.zh: 丙子，太陰犯心大星。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, the moon encroached upon the great star of the Heart constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the moon passed the great star of the Heart constellation.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，移山東統軍司於沂州。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, the Shandong Commandery was moved to Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the Shandong command headquarters was transferred to Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 萬戶重喜立十字路。

translations.literal: Wanhu Chongxi established Shizilu.
translations.idiomatic: Wanhu Chongxi established a garrison at Shizilu.

sentences.zh: 復正陽，命禿剌戍之。

translations.literal: Zhengyang was restored; Tula was ordered to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengyang was restored, and Tula was ordered to hold it.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以淇州隸懷孟路。

translations.literal: On jimao day, Qi Prefecture was placed under Huaimeng Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Qi Prefecture was placed under Huaimeng Circuit.

sentences.zh: 高麗國王王禃遣其臣榮胤伯奉表來賀聖誕節。

translations.literal: King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent his minister Rong Yinbo bearing a memorial to congratulate the Emperor on his birthday.
translations.idiomatic: King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent his minister Rong Yinbo with a memorial congratulating the Emperor on his birthday.

sentences.zh: 千戶闊闊出部民乏食，賜鈔賑之。

translations.literal: The people under Qianhu Kokuochu lacked food; paper money was granted for relief.
translations.idiomatic: The followers of Qianhu Kokuochu were short of food; the court granted paper money for relief.

sentences.zh: 王晉罷。

translations.literal: Wang Jin was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jin was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 樞密院臣言：「各路出征逃亡漢軍，及貧難未起戶，並投下隱匿事故者，宜一概發遣應役。

translations.literal: Privy Council officials said: "Han soldiers who fled while on campaign from all circuits, impoverished households not yet registered, and those hidden by appanage holders on pretext of exemption should all be conscripted and sent to serve.
translations.idiomatic: Privy council officials reported that Han soldiers who had deserted on campaign from every circuit, poor households not yet registered, and men hidden by appanage holders under false exemptions should all be drafted and sent to serve.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 敕行院及諸軍將校卒伍，須正身應役，違者罪之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered branch secretariat officials and all army commanders, officers, and rank-and-file to serve in person; violators were to be punished.
translations.idiomatic: An edict required branch secretariat officials and every army commander, officer, and soldier to serve in person; violators would be punished.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉，益都大蝗饑，命減價糶官粟以賑。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, xinyou day: Yidu suffered great locust plague and famine; an order was issued to sell government grain at reduced price for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinyou day, Yidu was ravaged by locusts and famine; the court ordered government grain sold at reduced price for relief.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，安南國王陳光丙遣使奉表來貢。

translations.literal: On guihai day, King Chen Guangbing of Annam sent envoys bearing a memorial as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day King Chen Guangbing of Annam sent envoys with tribute and a memorial.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔賜光丙至元三年曆。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, an edict granted Guangbing the calendar for the third year of Zhiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Emperor granted Guangbing the calendar for the third year of Zhiyuan.

sentences.zh: 八月丙子，濟南路鄒平縣進芝草一本。

translations.literal: Eighth month, bingzi day: Zouping County of Jinan Circuit presented one stalk of auspicious fungus.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingzi day, Zouping County in Jinan Circuit presented a stalk of auspicious fungus.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，高麗國王王禃遣使來貢方物。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent envoys bearing local products as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent envoys with local products as tribute.

sentences.zh: 己卯，諸宰職皆罷，以安童為中書右丞相，伯顏為中書左丞相。

translations.literal: On jimao day, all chief ministers were dismissed; Antong was made Right Chancellor of the Central Secretariat and Bayan Left Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day every chief minister was dismissed. Antong became right chancellor of the Central Secretariat and Bayan left chancellor.

sentences.zh: 戊子，召許衡於懷孟，楊誠於益都。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Xu Heng was summoned from Huaimeng and Yang Cheng from Yidu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Xu Heng was summoned from Huaimeng and Yang Cheng from Yidu.

sentences.zh: 車駕至自上都。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 九月戊戌，以將有事太廟，取大樂工於東平，預習儀禮。

translations.literal: Ninth month, wuxu day: Because there would soon be rites at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, great music masters were taken from Dongping to rehearse the ceremonial forms in advance.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuxu day, with rites at the Imperial Ancestral Temple approaching, great music masters were brought from Dongping to rehearse the ceremony in advance.

sentences.zh: 敕江淮沿邊樹柵，徐、宿、邳三州助役徒。

translations.literal: An edict ordered palisades planted along the Jiang-Huai frontier; Xu, Su, and Pi Prefectures were to supply corvée labor.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered palisades erected along the Jiang-Huai frontier, with Xu, Su, and Pi Prefectures supplying corvée labor.

sentences.zh: 庚子，皇孫鐵穆爾生。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, the imperial grandson Temür was born.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day the imperial grandson Temür was born.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，賞諸王只必帖木兒麾下河西戰功銀二百五十兩。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, two hundred fifty taels of silver were awarded for the Hexi campaign fought under Prince Jibtemur.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day two hundred fifty taels of silver were granted for the Hexi campaign fought under Prince Jibtemur.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，享於太廟。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, jimao day: Sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jimao day, sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 癸未，敕順天張柔、東平嚴忠濟、河間馬總管、濟南張林、太原石抹總管等戶，改隸民籍。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, an edict ordered the households of Zhang Rou of Shuntian, Yan Zhongji of Dongping, Ma, chief commissioner of Hejian, Zhang Lin of Jinan, Shi Mo, chief commissioner of Taiyuan, and others changed to civilian registration.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day an edict transferred the households of Zhang Rou of Shuntian, Yan Zhongji of Dongping, Chief Commissioner Ma of Hejian, Zhang Lin of Jinan, Chief Commissioner Shi Mo of Taiyuan, and others to civilian rolls.

sentences.zh: 統軍抄不花、萬戶懷都麾下軍士所俘宋人九十三口，官贖為民。

translations.literal: Ninety-three Song captives taken by soldiers under Commander Chaobuhua and Wanhu Huaidu were redeemed by the government and made civilians.
translations.idiomatic: Ninety-three Song captives taken by soldiers under Commander Chaobuhua and Wanhu Huaidu were redeemed by the government and registered as civilians.

sentences.zh: 其私越禁界掠獲者四十五人，許令親屬完聚，並種田內地。

translations.literal: Forty-five who had privately crossed the forbidden border and seized captives were permitted to reunite with relatives and farm in the interior.
translations.idiomatic: Forty-five men who had privately crossed the forbidden border to seize captives were allowed to rejoin their families and farm in the interior.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔隨路私商曾入南界者，首實免罪充軍。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, an edict stated that private merchants on each route who had once entered the southern territories, if they reported themselves first, would be pardoned and enrolled as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day an edict promised that private merchants on every route who had once entered Song territory would, if they came forward first, be pardoned and drafted as soldiers.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙申，召李昶於東平。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, bingshen day: Li Chang was summoned from Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingshen day, Li Chang was summoned from Dongping.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，賜諸王只必帖木兒銀二萬五千兩、鈔千錠。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, Prince Jibtemur was granted twenty-five thousand taels of silver and one thousand ingots of paper money.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Prince Jibtemur received twenty-five thousand taels of silver and one thousand ingots of paper money.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，賞楊文安戰功金五十兩，所部軍銀六百兩及幣帛有差。

translations.literal: On guichou day, Yang Wen'an was awarded fifty taels of gold for battle merit; his troops received six hundred taels of silver and graded silks and brocades.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Yang Wen'an received fifty taels of gold for battle merit, and his troops six hundred taels of silver plus graded silks and brocades.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔事故貧難軍不堪應役者，以兩戶或三戶合並正軍一名，其丁單力備者，許顧人應役。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, an edict stated that soldiers incapacitated by age or hardship and unable to serve might combine two or three households into one regular soldier; where a household had only one able-bodied man, he might hire a substitute to serve.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day an edict allowed soldiers broken by age or hardship and unfit for service to combine two or three households into one regular soldier, and where only one able-bodied man remained in a household, he might hire a substitute.

sentences.zh: 十二月己巳，省并州縣凡二百二十餘所。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jisi day: More than two hundred twenty prefectures and counties were consolidated or abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jisi day, more than two hundred twenty prefectures and counties were merged or abolished.

sentences.zh: 庚午，宋子貞言：「朝省之政，不宜數行數改。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, Song Zizhen said: "Court and secretariat policy should not be issued and changed repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Song Zizhen argued that court and secretariat policy should not be issued and changed so often.

sentences.zh: 又刑部所掌，事幹人命，尚書嚴忠範年少，宜選老於刑名者為之。

translations.literal: Moreover, the Ministry of Justice handles matters touching human life; Minister Yan Zhongfan is young — an elder versed in penal law should be chosen for the post.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Justice, he added, handled matters of life and death, yet Minister Yan Zhongfan was young; an elder versed in penal law should be appointed instead.

sentences.zh: 」又請罷北京行中書省，別立宣慰司以控制東北州郡。

translations.literal: " He also requested abolition of the Beijing Branch Secretariat and establishment of a separate Pacification Commission to control the northeastern prefectures and districts.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that the Beijing branch secretariat be abolished and a separate pacification commission set up to oversee the northeastern prefectures and districts.

sentences.zh: 並從之。

translations.literal: All of this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: All of this was approved.

sentences.zh: 禁朝省告訐以息爭訟。

translations.literal: Informers at court and in the secretariat were forbidden so as to reduce litigation.
translations.idiomatic: Informers at court and in the secretariat were banned to reduce litigation.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以諸王也速不花所部戍西番軍屢有戰功，賞銀三百兩。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, because the western frontier garrison under Prince Yesubhua had repeatedly won battle merit, three hundred taels of silver were awarded.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day three hundred taels of silver were granted because the western frontier garrison under Prince Yesubhua had repeatedly won battle merit.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，召張德輝於真定，徒單公履於衛州。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Zhang Dehui was summoned from Zhending and Tushan Gonglu from Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Zhang Dehui was summoned from Zhending and Tushan Gonglu from Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔諭高麗，賜至元三年曆日。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, an edict addressed Goryeo and granted the calendar for the third year of Zhiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict addressed Goryeo and granted the calendar for the third year of Zhiyuan.

sentences.zh: 癸未，賜劉秉忠金五十兩。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, Liu Bingzhong was granted fifty taels of gold.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Liu Bingzhong received fifty taels of gold.

sentences.zh: 甲申，賜伯顏、宋子貞、楊誠銀千兩、鈔六十錠。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, Bayan, Song Zizhen, and Yang Cheng were granted one thousand taels of silver and sixty ingots of paper money each.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Bayan, Song Zizhen, and Yang Cheng each received one thousand taels of silver and sixty ingots of paper money.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，敕選諸翼軍富強才勇者萬人，充侍衛親軍。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, an edict ordered selection of ten thousand strong and brave men from the various wings to serve as palace guard soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day an edict ordered ten thousand strong and brave men chosen from the various wings to serve as palace guard soldiers.

sentences.zh: 己丑，瀆山大玉海成，敕置廣寒殿。

translations.literal: On jichou day, the Great Jade Sea of Dushan was completed; an edict ordered the Hall of Broad Cold erected.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day the Great Jade Sea of Dushan was finished, and the Emperor ordered the Hall of Broad Cold built.

sentences.zh: 是歲，戶一百五十九萬七千六百一，絲九十八萬六千二百八十八斤，包銀鈔五萬七千六百八十二錠。

translations.literal: That year, households numbered one million five hundred ninety-seven thousand six hundred one; silk ninety-eight thousand six hundred eighty-eight jin; and wrapped-silver paper money fifty-seven thousand six hundred eighty-two ingots.
translations.idiomatic: That year registered households totaled one million five hundred ninety-seven thousand six hundred one; silk tribute ninety-eight thousand six hundred eighty-eight jin; and wrapped-silver paper money fifty-seven thousand six hundred eighty-two ingots.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王金、銀、幣、帛如歲例。

translations.literal: The princes were granted gold, silver, coin, and silk according to the annual custom.
translations.idiomatic: Princes received gold, silver, currency, and silk as in the annual custom.

sentences.zh: 彰德、大名、南京、河南府、濟南、淄萊、太原、弘州雹，西京、北京、益都、真定、東平、順德、河間、徐、宿、邳蝗旱，太原霜災。

translations.literal: Hail at Zhangde, Daming, Nanjing, Henan Prefecture, Jinan, Zilai, Taiyuan, and Hong Prefecture; locusts and drought at Xijing, Beijing, Yidu, Zhending, Dongping, Shunde, Hejian, Xu, Su, and Pi; frost damage at Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangde, Daming, Nanjing, Henan Prefecture, Jinan, Zilai, Taiyuan, and Hong were struck by hail; Xijing, Beijing, Yidu, Zhending, Dongping, Shunde, Hejian, Xu, Su, and Pi suffered locusts and drought; killing frost hit Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 斷死罪四十二人。

translations.literal: Forty-two persons were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: Forty-two persons were sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月乙未朔，高麗國王王禃遣使來賀。

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on the yimao new moon, King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent envoys to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on the yimao new moon of the first month of spring, King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent envoys with greetings.

sentences.zh: 丙午，遣朵端、趙璧持詔撫諭四川將吏軍民。

translations.literal: On bingwu day Duo Duan and Zhao Bi were dispatched bearing an edict to reassure and instruct the officers, troops, and people of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Duo Duan and Zhao Bi were sent with an edict to pacify Sichuan's officers, soldiers, and civilians.

sentences.zh: 壬子，立制國用使司，以阿合馬為使。

translations.literal: On renzi day the State Revenues Commission was established, with Ahmad as commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day the commission for state revenues was created and Ahmad was made its commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，選女直軍二千為侍衛軍。

translations.literal: On guichou day two thousand Jurchen troops were selected for the Palace Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day two thousand Jurchen soldiers were chosen for the palace guard.

sentences.zh: 四川行樞密院謀取嘉定，請益兵，命朵端、趙璧摘諸翼蒙古、漢軍六千人付之。

translations.literal: The Sichuan Branch Privy Council planned to take Jiading and requested reinforcements; Duo Duan and Zhao Bi were ordered to detach six thousand Mongol and Han troops from the various wings and hand them over.
translations.idiomatic: The Sichuan branch privy council planned an attack on Jiading and asked for reinforcements; Duo Duan and Zhao Bi were ordered to detach six thousand Mongol and Han troops from the various wings for the operation.

sentences.zh: 二月丙寅，廉希憲、宋子貞為平章政事，張文謙復為中書左丞，史天澤為樞密副使。

translations.literal: In the second month, on bingyin day, Lian Xixian and Song Zizhen were made Grand Councillors; Zhang Wenqian was restored as Left Vice Director of the Central Secretariat; Shi Tianze was made Deputy Privy Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day in the second month Lian Xixian and Song Zizhen were appointed grand councillors; Zhang Wenqian was restored as left vice director of the Central Secretariat; Shi Tianze was made deputy privy councillor.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，立沈州以處高麗降民。

translations.literal: On guiyou day Shen Prefecture was established to settle surrendered Goryeo people.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Shen Prefecture was created to resettle surrendered Goryeo subjects.

sentences.zh: 壬午，平陽路僧官以妖言惑眾伏誅。

translations.literal: On renwu day a Buddhist official of Pingyang Circuit who had deluded the people with heterodox talk was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day a Pingyang circuit monk-official who had led the people astray with heterodox preaching was put to death.

sentences.zh: 以中書右丞張易同知制國用使司事，參知政事，張惠為制國用副使。

translations.literal: Right Vice Director of the Central Secretariat Zhang Yi was made concurrent controller of the State Revenues Commission and Counsellor; Zhang Hui was made deputy commissioner of state revenues.
translations.idiomatic: Right vice director Zhang Yi was also put in charge of the state revenues commission as counsellor, and Zhang Hui was made its deputy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸未，車駕幸上都。

translations.literal: On guimao day the imperial carriage went to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the Emperor went to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 甲申，罷西夏行省，立宣慰司。

translations.literal: On jiashen day the Western Xia Branch Secretariat was abolished and a Pacification Commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the Western Xia branch secretariat was abolished and a pacification commission was set up in its place.

sentences.zh: 初制太常禮樂工冠服。

translations.literal: Regulations were first drawn up for the caps and robes of the Directorate of Ritual Music.
translations.idiomatic: The first regulations were issued for the caps and robes of the ritual-music directorate.

sentences.zh: 立東京、廣寧、懿州、開元、恤品、合懶、婆娑等路宣撫司。

translations.literal: Pacification commissions were established for the routes of Dongjing, Guangning, Yizhou, Kaiyuan, Tupin, Helan, and Posa.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification commissions were established at Dongjing, Guangning, Yizhou, Kaiyuan, Tupin, Helan, and Posa.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，蠲中都今年包銀四分之一。

translations.literal: On yiyou day one quarter of this year's lump-sum silver payment in the Central Capital was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day one quarter of this year's lump-sum silver dues in the Central Capital were remitted.

sentences.zh: 詔理斷阿術部下所俘人口、畜牧及其草地為民侵種者。

translations.literal: An edict ordered settlement of the captive population and livestock under Aju's command and of grasslands where civilians had encroached to plant crops.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered adjudication of captives and livestock under Aju's command and of grazing lands where civilians had encroached to farm.

sentences.zh: 以制國用使司條畫諭中外官吏。

translations.literal: The regulations of the State Revenues Commission were promulgated to officials within and without.
translations.idiomatic: The state revenues commission's regulations were issued to officials throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 三月辛巳，分衛輝路為親王玉龍答失分地。

translations.literal: In the third month, on xinsi day, Weihui Circuit was divided out as the appanage of Prince Yulong Tash.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day in the third month Weihui circuit was detached as the appanage of Prince Yulong Tash.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，賑水達達民戶饑。

translations.literal: On wuxu day the Uda households were given famine relief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Uda households received famine relief.

sentences.zh: 己未，王晉及侍中和哲斯、濟南益都轉運使王明，以隱匿鹽課，皆伏誅。

translations.literal: Wang Jin, Palace Attendant He Zhesi, and Transport Commissioner Wang Ming of Jinan and Yidu, for concealing salt levies, were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jin, palace attendant He Zhesi, and Wang Ming, transport commissioner of Jinan and Yidu, were all executed for concealing salt revenues.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁卯，五山珍禦榻成，置瓊華島廣寒殿。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on dingmao day, the Five Mountains rare-tribute couch was completed and the Broad Cold Hall was placed on Qionghua Isle.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day in the fourth month of summer the Five Mountains imperial couch was finished and the Broad Cold Hall was built on Qionghua Isle.

sentences.zh: 亳州水軍千戶胡進等領騎兵渡淝水，逾荊山，與宋兵戰，殺獲甚眾，賞鈔幣有差。

translations.literal: Hu Jin and others, wanhu of the Bozhou naval force, led cavalry across the Fei River, crossed Jing Mountain, fought Song troops, killed and captured a great multitude, and were rewarded with notes and silks in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Jin and other wanhu of the Bozhou naval force led cavalry across the Fei, crossed Jing Mountain, routed Song forces, and took many prisoners; they were rewarded with notes and silks in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 庚午，敕僧、道祈福於中都寺觀。

translations.literal: On gengwu day an order directed Buddhist and Daoist clergy to pray for blessings at temples and monasteries in the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Buddhist and Daoist clergy were ordered to pray for blessings at temples in the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 詔以僧機為總統，居廣壽寺。

translations.literal: An edict made Sengji overall supervisor and lodged him at Guangshou Temple.
translations.idiomatic: An edict named Sengji chief supervisor and installed him at Guangshou Temple.

sentences.zh: 己卯，申嚴瀕海私鹽之禁。

translations.literal: On jimao day the prohibition on coastal private salt was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day the ban on coastal private salt was sharply reinforced.

sentences.zh: 敕宮燭毋彩繪。

translations.literal: An order forbade painted decoration on palace candles.
translations.idiomatic: Palace candles were ordered kept free of painted decoration.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未，遣使諸路慮囚。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on yimao day, envoys were dispatched to every route to review prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day in the fifth month envoys were sent to every route to review prisoners.

sentences.zh: 庚子，敕太醫院領諸路醫戶、惠民藥局。

translations.literal: On gengzi day the Imperial Medical Academy was ordered to oversee medical households and public-benefit pharmacies on all routes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day the imperial medical academy was put in charge of medical households and public-benefit pharmacies on every route.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以黃金飾渾天儀。

translations.literal: On xinchou day the armillary sphere was gilded with gold.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day the armillary sphere was gilded with gold.

sentences.zh: 丙午，浚西夏中興漢延、唐來等渠。

translations.literal: On bingwu day the Hanyan, Tanglai, and other canals in Zhongxing, Western Xia, were dredged.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Hanyan, Tanglai, and other canals at Zhongxing in Western Xia were dredged.

sentences.zh: 凡良田為僧所據者，聽蒙古人分墾。

translations.literal: Where good fields had been taken by monks, Mongols were allowed to divide and cultivate them.
translations.idiomatic: Good farmland held by monks was opened to Mongols for divided cultivation.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，罷益都行省。

translations.literal: On bingchen day the Yidu Branch Secretariat was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the Yidu branch secretariat was abolished.

sentences.zh: 蠲平灤、益都質子戶賦稅之半。

translations.literal: Half the taxes of hostage households in Pingluan and Yidu were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Taxes on hostage households in Pingluan and Yidu were cut in half.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，封皇子南木合為北平王，以印給之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on dingmao day, Prince Namohe was enfeoffed as Prince of Beiping and given a seal.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day in the sixth month Prince Namohe was enfeoffed as Prince of Beiping and given a seal.

sentences.zh: 辛未，徙歸化民於清州興濟縣屯田，官給牛具。

translations.literal: On xinwei day people of Guizhou origin were moved to garrison farming at Xingji County in Qing Prefecture, and oxen and tools were supplied by the state.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Guizhou settlers were transferred to garrison farming at Xingji County in Qing Prefecture, with oxen and tools supplied by the state.

sentences.zh: 壬申，賜劉整畿內地五十頃。

translations.literal: On renshen day Liu Zheng was granted fifty qing of land within the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Liu Zheng received fifty qing of land within the capital region.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以千戶紥剌兒沒於王事，賜其妻銀二百五十兩。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, because the wanhu Zhazha'er had died in royal service, his wife was granted two hundred fifty taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, because wanhu Zhazha'er had died in the Emperor's service, his wife received two hundred fifty taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 丙子，立漕運司。

translations.literal: On bingzi day the Grain Transport Commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the grain transport commission was established.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以陜西行省平章賽典赤等政事修治，賜銀五千兩。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, because Grand Councillor Sayyid Ajall and others of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat had governed well, five thousand taels of silver were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Sayyid Ajall and his colleagues on the Shaanxi branch secretariat received five thousand taels of silver for effective administration.

sentences.zh: 命山東統軍副使王仲仁督造戰船於汴。

translations.literal: Deputy Commander-in-Chief Wang Zhongren of Shandong was ordered to supervise the building of warships at Bian.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhongren, deputy commander-in-chief of Shandong, was ordered to oversee warship construction at Bian.

sentences.zh: 申嚴陜西、河南竹禁。

translations.literal: The prohibition on bamboo in Shaanxi and Henan was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: The ban on bamboo in Shaanxi and Henan was sharply reinforced.

sentences.zh: 立拱衛司。

translations.literal: The Guard Command was established.
translations.idiomatic: The guard command was established.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙申，罷息州安撫司。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingshen day, the Xizhou Pacification Commission was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day in the seventh month of autumn the Xizhou pacification commission was abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔上都路總管府遇車駕巡幸，行留守司事，車駕還，即復舊。

translations.literal: On renyin day an edict stated that when the imperial carriage toured, the Shangdu Route chief office was to perform capital-garrison duties, and when the carriage returned it was to revert to its former functions.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day an edict ordered that when the Emperor toured, the Shangdu route chief office should act as the capital garrison administration, resuming its former duties when he returned.

sentences.zh: 丙午，遣使祀五嶽四瀆。

translations.literal: On bingwu day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the Five Sacred Peaks and Four Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day envoys were sent to offer sacrifice at the five sacred peaks and four great rivers.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，添內外巡兵。

translations.literal: On jiayin day patrol troops within and without were increased.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day patrol forces in the capital and in the provinces were increased.

sentences.zh: 外路每百戶選中產者一人充之，其賦令余戶代輸，在都增武衛軍四百。

translations.literal: On each outer route one person of middling means was chosen from every hundred households to serve; his levy was paid by the remaining households, and in the capital four hundred Wuwei Guard troops were added.
translations.idiomatic: In the outer routes one man of middling means was chosen from every hundred households to serve, with his tax paid by the rest; in the capital four hundred Wuwei guard troops were added.

sentences.zh: 己未，以崞、代、堅、臺四州隸忻州。

translations.literal: On jiwei day the four prefectures of Guo, Dai, Jian, and Tai were placed under Xin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Guo, Dai, Jian, and Tai prefectures were placed under Xin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 詔令西夏避亂之民還本籍，成都新民為豪家所庇者皆歸之州縣。

translations.literal: An edict ordered people of Western Xia who had fled disorder to return to their native registers, and new subjects in Chengdu sheltered by powerful families were all returned to their prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Western Xia refugees to return to their home registers, and Chengdu's new settlers sheltered by powerful families were returned to their counties and prefectures.

sentences.zh: 詔招集逃亡軍，限百日詣所屬陳首，原其罪，貧者並戶應役。

translations.literal: An edict summoned deserters from the army; within one hundred days they were to report to their units and confess, their crimes would be pardoned, and the poor might fulfill service jointly by household.
translations.idiomatic: An edict called in army deserters: within one hundred days they were to surrender to their units, receive pardon, and the poor might meet service obligations jointly by household.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，賜丞相伯顏第一區。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on guihai day, Grand Councillor Bayan was granted one residence.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day in the eighth month Grand Councillor Bayan received one residence.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以兵部侍郎黑的、禮部侍郎殷弘使日本，賜書曰：「皇帝奉書日本國王：朕惟自古小國之君，境土相接，尚務講信修睦，況我祖宗受天明命，奄有區夏，遐方異域畏威懷德者，不可悉數。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Vice Minister of War Hei Di and Vice Minister of Rites Yin Hong were sent as envoys to Japan, granted a letter stating: "The Emperor addresses the King of Japan: From of old, when rulers of small states shared a border, they still strove for good faith and friendly relations — how much more so, when my ancestors received Heaven's bright command and embraced all within the Four Seas, and countless distant lands and foreign regions have in awe of our might and admiration of our virtue submitted!"
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Hei Di, vice minister of war, and Yin Hong, vice minister of rites, were dispatched to Japan with a letter reading: "The Emperor to the King of Japan: Even rulers of small neighboring states have always sought trust and amity — how much more so for us, whose forebears received Heaven's mandate, rule all China, and count beyond number the far peoples who, awed by our power and drawn by our virtue, have bowed to us."

sentences.zh: 朕即位之初，以高麗無辜之民，久瘁鋒鏑，即令罷兵，還其疆埸，反其旄倪。

translations.literal: At the beginning of my reign, because the innocent people of Goryeo had long suffered under swords and spears, I immediately ordered troops withdrawn, their boundaries restored, and their old and young returned home.
translations.idiomatic: Early in my reign, seeing Goryeo's innocent people long wasted by war, I at once halted the armies, restored their borders, and sent their old and young home.

sentences.zh: 高麗君臣，感戴來朝，義雖君臣，而歡若父子。

translations.literal: The ruler and ministers of Goryeo, moved by gratitude, came to court; though the relation was that of lord and subject, their joy was like that between father and son.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo's king and ministers, full of gratitude, came to court; in name they were lord and subject, yet their warmth was like that of father and son.

sentences.zh: 計王之君臣，亦已知之。

translations.literal: I reckon that Your Majesty's ruler and ministers know this as well.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty's court knows this already, I am sure.

sentences.zh: 高麗，朕之東藩也。

translations.literal: Goryeo is my eastern vassal state.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo is Our eastern dependency.

sentences.zh: 日本密邇高麗，開國以來，時通中國，至於朕躬，而無一乘之使以通和好。

translations.literal: Japan lies close to Goryeo; since founding your state you have at times communicated with China — yet in my own reign not a single envoy has come to open friendly relations.
translations.idiomatic: Japan lies close to Goryeo. Since your kingdom was founded you have kept intermittent contact with China — yet under Our reign not one carriage of envoys has arrived to seek amity.

sentences.zh: 尚恐王國知之未審，故特遣使持書布告朕心，冀自今以往，通問結好，以相親睦。

translations.literal: Fearing that your kingdom may not yet know this fully, I specially send envoys bearing this letter to declare my heart's intent, hoping that from now on we may exchange messages and forge friendship, treating one another with close cordiality.
translations.idiomatic: Lest your kingdom be incompletely informed, I send envoys with this letter to make My intent plain, in hope that hereafter we may exchange messages, bind ourselves in friendship, and live as close allies.

sentences.zh: 且聖人以四海為家，不相通好，豈一家之理哉？

translations.literal: Moreover, the sage takes all within the Four Seas as one household — if we do not communicate in friendship, how can that accord with the principle of one family?
translations.idiomatic: The sage embraces the four seas as one home — how can we claim to be one family if we never greet each other in friendship?

sentences.zh: 以至用兵，夫孰所好，王其圖之。

translations.literal: As for resorting to arms, who truly desires it? Your Majesty should ponder this.
translations.idiomatic: War, when it comes — who truly wants it? Your Majesty should weigh this well.

sentences.zh: 」又詔高麗導去使至其國。

translations.literal: " Another edict ordered Goryeo to guide the departing envoys to that country.
translations.idiomatic: " Another edict ordered Goryeo to guide the envoys on to Japan.

sentences.zh: 戊子，高麗國王王禃遣其大將軍樸琪來賀聖誕節。

translations.literal: On wuzi day King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent his Grand General Pak Ki to congratulate the Emperor's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent his grand general Pak Ki to congratulate the Emperor on his birthday.

sentences.zh: 阿術略地蘄、黃，俘獲以萬計。

translations.literal: Aju raided the Qichuan and Huangzhou region; captives numbered in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Aju raided Qichuan and Huangzhou, taking tens of thousands of captives.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，車駕至自上都。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on wuwu day, the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day in the ninth month the Emperor returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚申朔，降德興府為奉聖州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the gengshen new moon, Dexing Prefecture was reduced to Fengsheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen new moon of the tenth month of winter Dexing Prefecture was demoted to Fengsheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，高麗使還，以王禃病，詔和藥賜之。

translations.literal: On guihai day the Goryeo envoys returned; because Wang Chon was ill, an edict ordered medicine compounded and granted to him.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the Goryeo envoys returned; learning that Wang Chon was ill, the court ordered medicine prepared and sent to him.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，徙平陽經籍所於京師。

translations.literal: On dingchou day the classics repository of Pingyang was moved to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Pingyang's classics repository was transferred to the capital.

sentences.zh: 更敕牒舊式。

translations.literal: The old form of edict-dispatch documents was revised.
translations.idiomatic: The old format for edict-dispatch documents was revised.

sentences.zh: 太廟成，丞相安童、伯顏言：「祖宗世數、尊謚廟號、增祀四世、各廟神主、配享功臣、法服祭器等事，皆宜定議。

translations.literal: When the Imperial Ancestral Temple was completed, Grand Councillors Antong and Bayan said: "The generations of the ancestors, honored posthumous names and temple names, the addition of four generations to the sacrifices, the spirit tablets of each temple, associated meritorious ministers, ritual robes, and sacrificial vessels — all these matters ought to be fixed by deliberation."
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial ancestral temple was finished, grand councillors Antong and Bayan memorialized: "Generations of ancestors, posthumous honors and temple names, worship of four additional generations, spirit tablets for each shrine, associated meritorious ministers, ritual robes, and sacrificial vessels — all should be settled by deliberation."

sentences.zh: 」命平章政事趙璧等集群臣議，定為八室。

translations.literal: " Grand Councillor Zhao Bi and others were ordered to gather the ministers for deliberation; eight chambers were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhao Bi and other grand councillors were ordered to assemble the ministers; eight chambers were decided upon.

sentences.zh: 申禁京畿畋獵。

translations.literal: Hunting in the capital region was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Hunting in the capital region was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 壬午，命制國用使司造神臂弓千張、矢六萬。

translations.literal: On renwu day the State Revenues Commission was ordered to manufacture one thousand divine-arm bows and sixty thousand arrows.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the state revenues commission was ordered to make one thousand divine-arm bows and sixty thousand arrows.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛卯，初給京、府、州、縣、司官吏俸及職田。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinmao day, salaries and official fields were first granted to officials of the capital, prefectures, counties, and bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day in the eleventh month salaries and official fields were first granted to officials of the capital, prefectures, counties, and bureaus.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，瀕御河立漕倉。

translations.literal: On wuxu day grain warehouses were established along the Imperial Canal.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day grain warehouses were built along the imperial canal.

sentences.zh: 丁未，申嚴殺牛馬之禁。

translations.literal: On dingwei day the prohibition on slaughtering cattle and horses was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the ban on slaughtering cattle and horses was sharply reinforced.

sentences.zh: 宋子貞致仁。

translations.literal: Song Zizhen resigned on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Song Zizhen resigned citing illness.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以忽都答兒為中書左丞相。

translations.literal: On xinhai day Hududar was made Left Grand Councillor of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Hududar was appointed left grand councillor of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 詔禁天文、圖讖等書。

translations.literal: An edict forbade books on astronomy, prognostication, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: An edict banned books on astronomy, prognostication, and related subjects.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，千戶散竹帶以嗜酒失所守大良平，罪當死，錄其前功免死，令往東川軍前自效。

translations.literal: On bingchen day the wanhu Sanzhudai, through drunkenness, lost the guard post at Daliangping; the crime merited death, but his prior merit was recorded and he was spared, being ordered to the eastern Sichuan front to redeem himself by service.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day wanhu Sanzhudai, drunk on duty, abandoned the post at Daliangping — a capital offense — but his earlier merit won him reprieve and he was sent to the eastern Sichuan front to redeem himself.

sentences.zh: 詔建都使復歸朝。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the capital-construction commissioner to return to court.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the capital-construction commissioner back to court.

sentences.zh: 又詔嘉定等府沿江一帶城堡早降。

translations.literal: Another edict urged the fortresses along the river in Jiading and other prefectures to submit early.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict called on riverside fortresses in Jiading and neighboring prefectures to surrender promptly.

sentences.zh: 又詔四川行樞密院遣人告諭江、漢、庸、蜀等效順，具官吏姓名，對階換授，有功者遷，有才者用；

translations.literal: Another edict ordered the Sichuan Branch Privy Council to send men to announce submission to the Jiang, Han, Yong, and Shu regions, listing officials' names by rank for replacement appointments — the meritorious were to be promoted, the capable employed;
translations.idiomatic: Another edict told the Sichuan branch privy council to send envoys urging submission in the Jiang, Han, Yong, and Shu regions, with officials' names listed by rank for new appointments — the meritorious to be promoted, the capable put to use;

sentences.zh: 民無生理者以衣糧賑之，願遷內地者給以田廬，毋令失所。

translations.literal: those among the people without livelihood were to be given clothing and grain in relief, and those wishing to move inland were to be granted fields and houses so that they would not be left destitute.
translations.idiomatic: people without means of living were to receive clothing and grain, and those who wished to move inland were to be given fields and houses so they would not be left destitute.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚申，給諸王合必赤行軍印。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengshen day, Prince Qebek was given a campaign seal.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day in the twelfth month Prince Qebek received a campaign seal.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔改四川行樞密院為行中書省，以賽典赤、也速帶兒等僉行中書省事。

translations.literal: On xinyou day an edict changed the Sichuan Branch Privy Council to a Branch Secretariat; Sayyid Ajall, Yesu Dai'er, and others were appointed to administer branch secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day an edict converted the Sichuan branch privy council into a branch secretariat, with Sayyid Ajall, Yesu Dai'er, and others placed in charge.

sentences.zh: 甲子，立諸路洞冶所。

translations.literal: On jiazi day smelting offices were established on all routes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day smelting offices were established on every route.

sentences.zh: 以梁成生擒宋總轄官，授同知開府事，佩金符。

translations.literal: Because Liang Cheng had captured a Song commander alive, he was appointed Vice Director of the Kaifu Office and granted a gold tally.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Cheng, who had taken a Song commander alive, was made vice director of the Kaifu office and given a gold tally.

sentences.zh: 減輝州竹課，先是官取十之六，至是減其二。

translations.literal: The bamboo levy of Hui Prefecture was reduced; previously the government took six-tenths, and now two-tenths were cut.
translations.idiomatic: Hui Prefecture's bamboo levy was reduced from six-tenths to four-tenths of the harvest.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔安肅公張柔、行工部尚書段天祐等同行工部事，修築宮城。

translations.literal: On dinghai day an edict ordered Duke of Ansou Zhang Rou, Acting Minister of Works Duan Tianyou, and others jointly to administer works affairs and repair the palace city.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day an edict ordered Duke Zhang Rou of Ansou, acting minister of works Duan Tianyou, and others to oversee public works and repair the palace city.

sentences.zh: 並太府監入宣徽院，仍以宣徽使專領監事。

translations.literal: The Directorate of the Imperial Storehouse was merged into the Palace Domestic Service, and the palace domestic commissioner was placed solely in charge of directorate affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial storehouse directorate was merged into the palace domestic service, with the palace domestic commissioner placed solely in charge.

sentences.zh: 詔賜高麗以至元四年曆日，仍慰諭之。

translations.literal: An edict granted Goryeo the calendar for the fourth year of Zhiyuan and sent words of reassurance.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted Goryeo the calendar for Zhiyuan 4 and sent words of reassurance.

sentences.zh: 建大安閣於上都。

translations.literal: The Great Peace Pavilion was built at Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Peace Pavilion was built at Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 鑿金口，導盧溝水以漕西山木石。

translations.literal: The Jinkou channel was opened to divert Lugou water for transporting timber and stone from the Western Hills by canal.
translations.idiomatic: The Jinkou sluice was opened to channel Lugou water and float timber and stone from the Western Hills by canal.

sentences.zh: 敕：「諸越界私商及諜人與偽造鈔者，送京師審核。

translations.literal: An order stated: "All private merchants crossing borders and spies, together with makers of forged notes, are to be sent to the capital for examination."
translations.idiomatic: An order declared: "Private cross-border traders, spies, and makers of forged notes are to be sent to the capital for review."

sentences.zh: 」是歲，天下戶一百六十萬九千九百三。

translations.literal: That year throughout the empire there were 1,609,903 households.
translations.idiomatic: That year the empire registered 1,609,903 households.

sentences.zh: 東平、濟南、益都、平灤、真定、洺磁、順天、中都、河間、北京蝗，京兆、鳳翔旱。

translations.literal: Locusts at Dongping, Jinan, Yidu, Pingluan, Zhending, Luoci, Shuntian, the Central Capital, Hejian, and Beijing; drought at Jingzhao and Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts plagued Dongping, Jinan, Yidu, Pingluan, Zhending, Luoci, Shuntian, the Central Capital, Hejian, and Beijing; Jingzhao and Fengxiang suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 斷死罪九十六人。

translations.literal: Ninety-six persons were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: Ninety-six persons were sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王金、銀、幣、帛如歲例。

translations.literal: The princes were granted gold, silver, coin, and silk according to the annual custom.
translations.idiomatic: Princes received gold, silver, currency, and silk as in the annual custom.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月甲午，陜西行省以開州新得復失，請益兵，敕平陽、延安等處簽民兵三千人，山東、河南、懷孟、潼川調兵七千人益之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on jiawu day, the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat reported that Kaizhou had been newly taken and then lost again and requested reinforcements; an edict ordered three thousand militia conscripted at Pingyang, Yan'an, and elsewhere, and seven thousand troops transferred from Shandong, Henan, Huaimeng, and Tongchuan to reinforce them.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fourth year, on jiawu day of the first month, the Shaanxi branch secretariat reported that Kaizhou had been retaken and lost again and asked for reinforcements; the court ordered three thousand militia levied at Pingyang, Yan'an, and elsewhere and seven thousand troops from Shandong, Henan, Huaimeng, and Tongchuan to reinforce them.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，申嚴平陽等處私鹽之禁。

translations.literal: On dingyou day the prohibition against private salt in Pingyang and elsewhere was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the ban on private salt in Pingyang and elsewhere was reaffirmed.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，立茶速禿水十四驛。

translations.literal: On renyin day fourteen relay stations were established at Chasutu River.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day fourteen relay stations were set up along the Chasutu River.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，敕修曲阜宣聖廟。

translations.literal: On guimao day an edict ordered the repair of the Sage-of-State Temple at Qufu.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day an edict ordered repairs to the Sage-of-State Temple at Qufu.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，百濟遣其臣梁浩來朝，賜以錦繡有差。

translations.literal: On yisi day Baekje sent its minister Liang Hao to court; he was granted brocades according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Baekje sent the minister Liang Hao to court and rewarded him with brocades according to rank.

sentences.zh: 禁僧官侵理民訟。

translations.literal: Buddhist clerical officials were forbidden to intrude in civilian lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: Buddhist clerical officials were forbidden to take up civilian lawsuits.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，封安肅公張柔為蔡國公，以趙璧為樞密副使。

translations.literal: On xinhai day Duke of Ansul Zhang Rou was enfeoffed as Duke of Cai; Zhao Bi was made Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Zhang Rou, Duke of Ansul, was invested as Duke of Cai, and Zhao Bi was appointed Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 立諸路洞冶都總管府。

translations.literal: A Directorate-General for Mining and Smelting was established in all routes.
translations.idiomatic: Directorate-generals for mining and smelting were established in every route.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，敕封昔木土山為武定山，其神曰武定公；

translations.literal: On guichou day an edict enfeoffed Mount Ximu as Mount Wuding, its spirit as Lord Wuding;
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day an edict named Mount Ximu Mount Wuding and enfeoffed its spirit as Lord Wuding;

sentences.zh: 泉為靈淵，其神曰靈淵侯。

translations.literal: and the spring as Lingyuan, its spirit as Marquis Lingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: and the spring as Lingyuan, with its spirit enfeoffed as Marquis Lingyuan.

sentences.zh: 簽蒙古軍，戶二丁三丁者出一人為軍，四丁五丁者二人，六丁七丁者三人。

translations.literal: Mongol troops were conscripted: households with two or three adult males furnished one soldier, those with four or five furnished two, those with six or seven furnished three.
translations.idiomatic: Mongol troops were levied on a sliding scale: households of two or three adult males supplied one soldier, those of four or five supplied two, and those of six or seven supplied three.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，高麗國王王禃遣使來朝，詔撫慰之。

translations.literal: On yimao day the King of Goryeo, Wang Chŏn, sent envoys to court; an edict comforted them.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent envoys to court, and an edict comforted them.

sentences.zh: 戊午，立提點宮城所。

translations.literal: On wuwu day an Office for Palace City Oversight was established.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day an office for palace-city oversight was established.

sentences.zh: 析上都隆興府自為一路，行總管府事；

translations.literal: Shangdu's Longxing Prefecture was split off as a separate circuit, conducting branch commissioner affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Longxing Prefecture in Shangdu was detached as its own circuit, with a branch commissioner conducting its affairs;

sentences.zh: 立開元等路轉運司。

translations.literal: Transport Commissions were established at Kaiyuan and other routes.
translations.idiomatic: Transport commissions were established at Kaiyuan and other routes.

sentences.zh: 城大都。

translations.literal: Dadu was walled.
translations.idiomatic: The walls of Dadu were built.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，粘合南合復平章事，阿裏復為中書右丞。

translations.literal: In the second month, on gengshen day, Nianhe Nanhe was restored as Grand Councillor, and Ali was restored as Right Associate of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengshen day, Nianhe Nanhe was restored as grand councillor and Ali as Right Associate of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，改經籍所為弘文院，以馬天昭知院事。

translations.literal: On dingmao day the Classics Archive was renamed the Academy of Literary Glory, with Ma Tianzhao as director.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Classics Archive was renamed the Academy of Literary Glory, with Ma Tianzhao placed in charge.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，括西夏民田，征其租。

translations.literal: On dinghai day Xixia civilian fields were registered and their rents levied.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day civilian fields in Xixia were surveyed and their rents collected.

sentences.zh: 車駕幸上都。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor traveled to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 詔陜西行省招諭宋人。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat to summon and persuade the Song people.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Shaanxi branch secretariat to summon and win over the Song people.

sentences.zh: 又詔嘉定、瀘州、重慶、夔府、涪、達、忠、萬及釣魚、禮義、大良等處官吏軍民有能率眾來降者，優加賞擢。

translations.literal: Another edict declared that officials, troops, and civilians at Jiading, Luzhou, Chongqing, Kuizhou, Fu, Da, Zhong, Wan, and Diaoyu, Liyi, Daliang, and elsewhere who could lead the masses to surrender would be generously rewarded and promoted.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict promised generous rewards and promotion to officials, soldiers, and civilians at Jiading, Luzhou, Chongqing, Kuizhou, Fu, Da, Zhong, Wan, Diaoyu, Liyi, Daliang, and elsewhere who could bring their followers over in surrender.

sentences.zh: 三月己丑，復以耶律鑄為中書左丞相。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jichou day, Yelü Zhu was again made Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jichou day, Yelü Zhu was again appointed Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，自潼關至蘄縣立河渡官八員，以察奸偽。

translations.literal: On xinmao day eight river-crossing inspectors were established from Tong Pass to Qi County to detect deceit.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day eight river-crossing inspectors were posted from Tong Pass to Qi County to detect fraud.

sentences.zh: 乙未，敕中都路建習樂堂，使樂工隸業其中。

translations.literal: On yiwei day an edict ordered a Music Practice Hall built on the Central Capital route and musicians assigned to train there.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day an edict ordered a Music Practice Hall built on the Central Capital route and musicians assigned to train there.

sentences.zh: 己亥，賜皇子燕王、忙阿剌、那沒罕、忽哥赤銀三萬兩。

translations.literal: On jihai day Princes Yan, Mangqala, Namaghan, and Hügechi were granted thirty thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Princes Yan, Mangqala, Namaghan, and Hügechi received thirty thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，夏津縣大雨雹。

translations.literal: On xinchou day Xiajin County suffered heavy hail.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Xiajin County was struck by heavy hail.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，安童言：「比者省官員數，平章、左丞各一員，今丞相五人，素無此例。

translations.literal: On renyin day Antong said: "Recently the secretariat establishment provided for one Grand Councillor and one Left Associate each; now there are five chancellors, which has never been the precedent.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Antong said: "The secretariat establishment recently allowed for one grand councillor and one left associate each, but now there are five chancellors — a number without precedent.

sentences.zh: 臣等議擬設二丞相，臣等蒙古人三員，惟陛下所命。

translations.literal: We propose setting two chancellors; three of us are Mongols and await Your Majesty's appointment.
translations.idiomatic: We propose appointing two chancellors; three of us are Mongols and await Your Majesty's command.

sentences.zh: 」詔以安童為長，史天澤次之，其餘蒙古、漢人參用，勿令員數過多；

translations.literal: " An edict made Antong chief, Shi Tiane second; the rest were to be Mongols and Han used together, without letting the number grow too large;
translations.idiomatic: " An edict made Antong chief and Shi Tiane second; the remaining posts were to be filled by Mongols and Han in combination, without letting the number grow too large;

sentences.zh: 又詔宜用老成人如姚樞等一二員同議省事。

translations.literal: and another edict recommended one or two senior men such as Yao Shu to join in deliberating secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: and another edict recommended that one or two senior men such as Yao Shu join in deliberating secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，耶律鑄制宮縣樂成，詔賜名《大成》。

translations.literal: On dingsi day Yelü Zhu completed palace and county music; an edict granted it the title "Great Accomplishment."
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Yelü Zhu completed the palace and county music, and an edict named it "Great Accomplishment."

sentences.zh: 夏四月申子，新築宮城。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on shenzi day, the palace city was newly built.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on shenzi day, the palace city was newly built.

sentences.zh: 辛未，遣使祀嶽瀆。

translations.literal: On xinwei day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day envoys were sent to offer sacrifice at the mountains and rivers.

sentences.zh: 五月丁亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on dinghai day, the first of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, the first of the fifth month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 敕上都重建孔子廟。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Confucius Temple at Shangdu rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Confucius Temple at Shangdu rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 乙未，應州大水。

translations.literal: On yiwei day Ying Prefecture suffered great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Ying Prefecture was flooded.

sentences.zh: 丙申，威州山後大番弄麻等十一族來附，賜以璽書、金銀符。

translations.literal: On bingshen day eleven tribes including the Great Fan Nongma behind Weizhou submitted; they were granted imperial patents and gold and silver tally seals.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day eleven tribes including the Great Fan Nongma behind Weizhou submitted and received imperial patents and gold and silver tally seals.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以捕獵戶達魯花赤偽造銀符，處死。

translations.literal: On jiyou day a darughachi of the hunting households was executed for forging silver tally seals.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day a darughachi of the hunting households was put to death for forging silver tally seals.

sentences.zh: 壬子，敕諸路官吏俸，令包銀民戶，每四兩增納一兩以給之。

translations.literal: On renzi day an edict on official salaries in all routes ordered silver-tax households to pay one extra tael per four taels to supply them.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day an edict on official salaries in every route ordered silver-tax households to pay one additional tael for every four taels to fund them.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，析東平之博州五城別為一路。

translations.literal: On bingchen day five cities of Bozhou in Dongping were split off as a separate circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day five cities of Bozhou in Dongping were detached as a separate circuit.

sentences.zh: 六月壬戌，以中都、順天、東平等處蠶災，免民戶絲料輕重有差。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on renxu day, because silkworm disasters afflicted the Central Capital, Shuntian, Dongping, and elsewhere, households' silk levies were remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renxu day, silkworm disasters in the Central Capital, Shuntian, Dongping, and elsewhere brought remission of silk levies in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，復以史天澤為中書左丞相，忽都答兒、耶律鑄並降平章政事，伯顏降中書右丞，廉希憲降中書左丞，阿裏、張文謙並降參知政事。

translations.literal: On yichou day Shi Tiane was again made Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat; Qutudar and Yelü Zhu were both demoted to Grand Councillors, Bayan was demoted to Right Associate, Lian Xixian to Left Associate, and Ali and Zhang Wenqian were both demoted to Vice Grand Councillors.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Shi Tiane was again made Left Chancellor; Qutudar and Yelü Zhu were both reduced to grand councillors, Bayan to Right Associate, Lian Xixian to Left Associate, and Ali and Zhang Wenqian to vice grand councillors.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，賜諸王玉龍答失銀五千兩、幣三百，歲以為常。

translations.literal: On yiyou day Prince Yisibuge was granted five thousand taels of silver and three hundred bolts; this became annual.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Prince Yisibuge received five thousand taels of silver and three hundred bolts, to be granted annually thereafter.

sentences.zh: 罷宣徽院。

translations.literal: The Palace Provisioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Provisioner was abolished.

sentences.zh: 黑的、殷弘以高麗使者宋君斐、金贊不能導達至日本來奏，降詔責高麗王王禃，仍令其遣官至彼宣布，以必得要領為期。

translations.literal: Qara and Yin Hong reported that Goryeo envoys Song Junfei and Jin Zan had failed to guide the mission through to Japan; an edict rebuked King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo and ordered him to send officials there to proclaim the Emperor's will, with obtaining results as the deadline.
