translations.idiomatic: Qara and Yin Hong reported that the Goryeo envoys Song Junfei and Jin Zan had failed to guide the mission through to Japan; an edict rebuked King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo and ordered him to send officials there to proclaim the Emperor's will, with concrete results as the deadline.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙戌朔，敕自中興路至西京之東勝立水驛十。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on bingxu day, the first of the month, an edict ordered ten water relay stations established from Zhongxing Route to Dongsheng west of Xijing.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingxu day, the first of the month, an edict ordered ten water relay stations built from Zhongxing Route to Dongsheng west of Xijing.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，罷息州安撫嶽林，以其民隸南京路；

translations.literal: On wuxu day Yue Lin, Pacification Commissioner of Xizhou, was dismissed and his people placed under Nanjing Route;
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Yue Lin, pacification commissioner of Xizhou, was dismissed and his people placed under Nanjing Route;

sentences.zh: 罷懷孟路安撫李宗傑，以其民隸本路。

translations.literal: Pacification Commissioner Li Zongjie of Huaimeng Route was dismissed and his people placed under that route.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zongjie, pacification commissioner of Huaimeng Route, was dismissed and his people placed under that route.

sentences.zh: 發鞏昌、鳳翔、京兆等處未占籍戶一千，修治四川山路、橋梁、棧道。

translations.literal: One thousand unregistered households in Gongchang, Fengxiang, Jingzhao, and elsewhere were mobilized to repair Sichuan mountain roads, bridges, and plank paths.
translations.idiomatic: One thousand unregistered households in Gongchang, Fengxiang, Jingzhao, and elsewhere were mobilized to repair mountain roads, bridges, and plank paths in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 大名路達魯花赤愛魯、總管張弘範等盜用官錢，罷之。

translations.literal: Ailu, darughachi of Daming Route, and Prefect Zhang Hongfan and others misappropriated government money and were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Ailu, darughachi of Daming Route, and the prefect Zhang Hongfan and others misappropriated government funds and were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，申嚴京畿牧地之禁。

translations.literal: On renyin day the prohibition against pasturing in the capital region was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the ban on pasturing in the capital region was reaffirmed.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔亦即納新附貧民，從人借貸困不能償者，官為償之，仍給牛具、種實及糧食。

translations.literal: On jiayin day an edict stated that among newly submitted poor of Yijina who had borrowed and could not repay, the government would repay for them and also provide oxen, tools, seed, and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day an edict declared that among newly submitted poor in Yijina who had borrowed and could not repay, the government would repay their debts and also provide oxen, tools, seed, and grain.

sentences.zh: 簽東京軍千八百人充侍衛軍。

translations.literal: One thousand eight hundred troops from the Eastern Capital army were conscripted to serve in the Palace Guard.
translations.idiomatic: One thousand eight hundred Eastern Capital troops were levied for the Palace Guard.

sentences.zh: 八月庚申，填星犯天樽。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on gengshen day, Saturn encroached on Tianzun.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengshen day, Saturn encroached on Tianzun.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，申嚴平灤路私鹽酒醋之禁。

translations.literal: On xinyou day the prohibition against private salt, wine, and vinegar on the Pingluan Route was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the ban on private salt, wine, and vinegar on the Pingluan Route was reaffirmed.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，復立宣徽院，以前中書右丞相線真為使。

translations.literal: On bingyin day the Palace Provisioner was reestablished, with the former Right Chancellor Xian Zhen as commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Palace Provisioner was restored, with the former Right Chancellor Xian Zhen as commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，封皇子忽哥赤為雲南王，賜駝鈕金鍍銀印。

translations.literal: On dingchou day Prince Hügechi was enfeoffed as Prince of Yunnan and granted a gold-plated silver seal with camel-shaped knob.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Prince Hügechi was invested as Prince of Yunnan and granted a gold-plated silver seal with a camel-shaped knob.

sentences.zh: 壬午，太白犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: On renwu day Venus encroached on the great star of Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Venus encroached on the great star of Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 命怯綿征建都。

translations.literal: Qiemian was ordered to campaign against Jiandu.
translations.idiomatic: Qiemian was ordered to campaign against Jiandu.

sentences.zh: 高麗國王王禃遣其秘書監郭汝弼來賀聖誕節。

translations.literal: King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent his Secretariat Director Guo Rubi to congratulate the Emperor's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent his secretariat director Guo Rubi to congratulate the Emperor on his birthday.

sentences.zh: 阿術略地至襄陽，俘生口五萬、馬牛五千。

translations.literal: Aju raided as far as Xiangyang, capturing fifty thousand persons and five thousand horses and cattle.
translations.idiomatic: Aju raided as far as Xiangyang and captured fifty thousand people and five thousand horses and cattle.

sentences.zh: 宋人遣步騎來拒，阿術率騎兵敗之。

translations.literal: The Song sent infantry and cavalry to resist; Aju led cavalry and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The Song sent infantry and cavalry to resist, but Aju led cavalry and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰，作玉殿於廣寒殿中。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renchen day, a jade hall was built within the Broad Cold Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renchen day, a jade hall was built within the Broad Cold Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙未，總帥汪良臣請立寨於毋章德山，控扼江南，以當釣魚之沖，從之。

translations.literal: On yiwei day Grand Commander Wang Liangchen requested a fort at Wuzhangde Mountain to control Jiangnan and block the approach to Diaoyu; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Grand Commander Wang Liangchen asked to build a fort at Wuzhangde Mountain to control Jiangnan and block the approach to Diaoyu; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以許衡為國子祭酒。

translations.literal: On wushen day Xu Heng was made Chancellor of the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Xu Heng was appointed Chancellor of the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 安南國王陳光丙遣使來貢，優詔答之。

translations.literal: King Tran Quang Binh of Annam sent envoys with tribute; a gracious edict replied.
translations.idiomatic: King Tran Quang Binh of Annam sent envoys with tribute, and a gracious edict replied.

sentences.zh: 立大理等處行六部，以闊闊帶為尚書兼雲南王傅，柴禎尚書兼府尉，寧源侍郎兼司馬。

translations.literal: The Six Ministries branch was established at Dali and elsewhere; Kuokuodai was made Minister and concurrently Tutor to the Prince of Yunnan, Chai Zhen Minister and concurrently Prefect Commandant, and Ning Yuan Vice Minister and concurrently Chief of Staff.
translations.idiomatic: A branch Six Ministries was established at Dali and elsewhere; Kuokuodai was made minister and concurrently tutor to the Prince of Yunnan, Chai Zhen minister and concurrently prefect commandant, and Ning Yuan vice minister and concurrently chief of staff.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，遣雲南王忽哥赤鎮大理、鄯闡、茶罕章、赤禿哥兒、金齒等處，詔撫諭吏民。

translations.literal: On gengxu day Prince Hügechi of Yunnan was dispatched to garrison Dali, Shanchan, Chahanzhang, Chituo'ge'er, Jinchi, and elsewhere; an edict comforted officials and people.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Prince Hügechi of Yunnan was sent to garrison Dali, Shanchan, Chahanzhang, Chituo'ge'er, Jinchi, and elsewhere, and an edict comforted officials and people.

sentences.zh: 又詔諭安南國，俾其君長來朝，子弟入質，編民出軍役、納賦稅，置達魯花赤統治之。

translations.literal: Another edict instructed Annam that its ruler should come to court, sons and younger brothers should serve as hostages, registered people should furnish military service and pay taxes, and a darughachi should be placed to govern them.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict instructed Annam that its ruler should come to court, sons and younger brothers should serve as hostages, registered people should furnish military service and pay taxes, and a darughachi should be placed to govern them.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，申嚴西夏中興等路僧尼、道士商稅、酒醋之禁。

translations.literal: On guichou day the prohibition against monks, nuns, and Daoist priests engaging in commercial tax, wine, and vinegar in Xixia, Zhongxing, and other routes was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the ban on monks, nuns, and Daoist priests trading in commercial tax, wine, and vinegar in Xixia, Zhongxing, and other routes was reaffirmed.

sentences.zh: 車駕至自上都。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 王鶚請立選舉法，有旨令議舉行，有司難之，事遂寢。

translations.literal: Wang E requested establishing an examination and selection law; an imperial directive ordered discussion for implementation, but the responsible offices objected and the matter was dropped.
translations.idiomatic: Wang E asked to establish an examination and selection law; an imperial directive ordered discussion for implementation, but the responsible offices objected and the matter was dropped.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛酉，制國用司言：「別怯赤山石絨織為布，火不能然。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on xinyou day, the State Revenue Office reported: "At Bieqiechi Mountain, stone wool woven into cloth cannot be burned by fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on xinyou day, the State Revenue Office reported: "At Bieqiechi Mountain, stone wool woven into cloth cannot be burned by fire.

sentences.zh: 」詔采之。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered it collected.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered it collected.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，賜駙馬不花銀印。

translations.literal: On renxu day the imperial son-in-law Buhua was granted a silver seal.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day the imperial son-in-law Buhua received a silver seal.

sentences.zh: 魚通巖州等處達魯花赤李福招諭西番諸族酋長以其民入附，以阿奴版的哥等為喝吾等處總管，並授璽書及金銀符。

translations.literal: Li Fu, darughachi of Yutong and Yan Prefectures, summoned western Tibetan tribal chiefs to bring their people in submission; Anubandige and others were made administrators of Hewu and elsewhere, all granted imperial patents and gold and silver tally seals.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fu, darughachi of Yutong and Yan Prefectures, summoned western Tibetan tribal chiefs to bring their people in submission; Anubandige and others were made administrators of Hewu and elsewhere and granted imperial patents and gold and silver tally seals.

sentences.zh: 鐵旗城後番官官折蘭遣其子天郎持先受憲宗璽書、金符，乞改授新命，從之。

translations.literal: Zalan, a western Tibetan official of Tieqi Cheng, sent his son Tianlang bearing patents and gold seals previously received from Prince Möngke to request new appointments; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Zalan, a western Tibetan official of Tieqi Cheng, sent his son Tianlang with patents and gold seals previously received from Prince Möngke to request new appointments; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，歲星犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: On jiazi day Jupiter encroached on the great star of Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Jupiter encroached on the great star of Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 辛未，太原進嘉禾二本，異畝同穎。

translations.literal: On xinwei day Taiyuan presented two stalks of fine grain from different fields sharing one ear.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Taiyuan presented two stalks of fine grain from different fields sharing one ear.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，賑新附民陳忠等鈔。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day paper notes were issued in relief to newly submitted civilians including Chen Zhong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day paper notes were issued in relief to newly submitted civilians including Chen Zhong.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，制國用使司請量節經用，從之。

translations.literal: The State Revenue Commissioner requested measured reduction of routine expenditures; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The state revenue commissioner asked for measured reduction of routine expenditures, and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，定品官子孫蔭敘格。

translations.literal: On gengchen day regulations were fixed for hereditary preferment of officials' sons and grandsons by rank.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day regulations were fixed for hereditary preferment of officials' sons and grandsons by rank.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，享於太廟。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on yiyou day, sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yiyou day, sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，立新蔡縣，以忽察、李家奴統所部兵戍之。

translations.literal: On wuxu day Xin'ai County was established; Huocha and Li Gianu were placed in command of their troops to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Xin'ai County was established, with Huocha and Li Gianu placed in command of their troops to garrison it.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，立夔府路總帥府，戍開州。

translations.literal: On jiachen day a Grand Commander headquarters was established on the Kuifu Route to garrison Kaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day a grand commander headquarters was established on the Kuifu Route to garrison Kaizhou.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，填星犯天樽距星。

translations.literal: On yisi day Saturn encroached on Tianzun's companion star.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Saturn encroached on Tianzun's companion star.

sentences.zh: 申嚴京畿畋獵之禁。

translations.literal: The prohibition against hunting in the capital region was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: The ban on hunting in the capital region was reaffirmed.

sentences.zh: 南京宣慰劉整赴闕，奏攻宋方略，宜先從事襄陽。

translations.literal: Liu Zheng, Branch Pacification Commissioner of Nanjing, came to court and memorialized that the strategy against Song should begin with Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zheng, branch pacification commissioner of Nanjing, came to court and argued that the campaign against Song should begin with Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，賞河南路統軍使訥懷所部將士戰功銀九千六百五十兩，鈔幣、鞍勒有差。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu day, nine thousand six hundred fifty taels of silver were granted in reward for battle merit to officers and soldiers under Nahuai, commander-in-chief of Henan Route, with paper notes, bolts, and saddles and bridles according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu day, nine thousand six hundred fifty taels of silver were granted in reward for battle merit to officers and soldiers under Nahuai, commander-in-chief of Henan Route, with paper notes, bolts, and saddles and bridles according to rank.

sentences.zh: 丙子，賑親王移相哥所部饑民。

translations.literal: On bingzi day Prince Yisangge's starving subjects received relief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day starving subjects under Prince Yisangge received relief.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，給遼東新簽軍布六萬匹。

translations.literal: On dingchou day sixty thousand bolts of cloth were issued to newly conscripted troops in Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day sixty thousand bolts of cloth were issued to newly conscripted troops in Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 己卯，立遼東路水驛七。

translations.literal: On jimao day seven water relay stations were established on the Liaodong Route.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day seven water relay stations were established on the Liaodong Route.

sentences.zh: 賞元帥阿術部下有功將士二千二十五人，銀五萬五千三百兩、金五十兩，及錦彩、鞍勒有差。

translations.literal: Two thousand twenty-five meritorious officers and soldiers under Marshal Aju were rewarded with fifty-five thousand three hundred taels of silver and fifty taels of gold, plus brocades, saddles, and bridles according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two thousand twenty-five meritorious officers and soldiers under Marshal Aju received fifty-five thousand three hundred taels of silver and fifty taels of gold, plus brocades, saddles, and bridles according to rank.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，簽女直、水達達軍三千人。

translations.literal: On gengchen day three thousand Jurchen and Suiban troops were conscripted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day three thousand Jurchen and Suiban troops were levied.

sentences.zh: 立諸位斡脫總管府。

translations.literal: A Directorate-General for Ortogh of the Princes was established.
translations.idiomatic: A directorate-general for the princes' ortogh was established.

sentences.zh: 省平陽路嶽陽、和州二縣入冀氏，復置霸州益津縣，省安西路櫟陽縣入臨潼。

translations.literal: Yueyang and Hezhou counties in Pingyang Route were annexed into Jishi; Yijin County in Bazhou was restored; Liyang County in Anxi Route was annexed into Lintong.
translations.idiomatic: Yueyang and Hezhou counties in Pingyang Route were annexed into Jishi; Yijin County in Bazhou was restored; and Liyang County in Anxi Route was annexed into Lintong.

sentences.zh: 是歲，天下戶口一百六十四萬四千三十。

translations.literal: That year throughout the empire there were 1,644,030 households.
translations.idiomatic: That year the empire registered 1,644,030 households.

sentences.zh: 山東、河南北諸路蝗，順天束鹿縣旱，免其租。

translations.literal: Locusts afflicted Shandong, northern Henan, and other routes; Shulu County in Shuntian suffered drought; rents were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts struck Shandong, northern Henan, and other routes; Shulu County in Shuntian suffered drought; rents were remitted.

sentences.zh: 斷死罪一百十四人。

translations.literal: One hundred fourteen persons were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred fourteen persons were sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王金、銀、幣、帛如歲例。

translations.literal: Gold, silver, silk currency, and cloth were granted to the princes according to the annual precedent.
translations.idiomatic: The princes received gold, silver, silk currency, and cloth according to annual custom.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月甲午，太陰犯井。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on jiawu day, the moon encroached on Jing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on jiawu day in the first month of spring, the moon passed through Jing.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上都建城隍廟。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, a City God temple was built at Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day a City God temple was built at Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，敕陜西五路四川行省造戰艦五百艘付劉整。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, an edict ordered the five circuits of Shaanxi and the Sichuan Branch Secretariat to build five hundred war vessels and deliver them to Liu Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day an edict ordered Shaanxi's five circuits and the Sichuan branch secretariat to build five hundred war vessels for Liu Zheng.

sentences.zh: 高麗國王王禃遣其弟淐來朝。

translations.literal: King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent his younger brother Cheo to court.
translations.idiomatic: King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent his younger brother Cheo to court.

sentences.zh: 詔以禃飾辭見欺，面數其事於淐，切責之。

translations.literal: An edict stated that Chon had tried to deceive with polished words; the emperor confronted Cheo face to face with the facts and sharply rebuked him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict charged that Chon had deceived them with polished rhetoric; the emperor confronted Cheo directly with the facts and sharply rebuked him.

sentences.zh: 復遣北京路總管於也孫脫、禮部郎中孟甲持詔往諭，令具表遣海陽公金俊、侍郎李藏用與去使同來以聞。

translations.literal: Yeyasutai, Route-intendant of Beiping, and Meng Jia, Section Director in the Ministry of Rites, were again dispatched to carry an edict and instruct them, ordering them to submit a memorial and send Prince Haiyang Jin Jun and Vice Minister Li Zangyong to return with the departing envoys and report.
translations.idiomatic: Yeyasutai, intendant of Beiping route, and Meng Jia of the Ministry of Rites were sent again with an edict instructing Goryeo to submit a memorial and dispatch Prince Haiyang Jin Jun and Vice Minister Li Zangyong to return with the outgoing envoys and report.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，賜高麗國新歷。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, a new calendar was granted to Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day a new calendar was granted to Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊午，以陳、亳、潁、蔡等處屯田戶充軍；

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on wuwu day, garrison-farming households at Chen, Bo, Ying, Cai and other posts were conscripted as soldiers;
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on wuwu day, garrison-farming households at Chen, Bo, Ying, Cai, and other posts were drafted as soldiers;

sentences.zh: 令益都漏籍戶四千淘金登州棲霞縣，每戶輸金歲四錢。

translations.literal: Four thousand unregistered households in Yidu were ordered to pan gold at Qixia County in Dengzhou; each household was to deliver four qian of gold annually.
translations.idiomatic: Four thousand unregistered Yidu households were ordered to pan for gold at Qixia County in Dengzhou, each to deliver four qian of gold per year.

sentences.zh: 二月戊子，太陰犯天關。

translations.literal: Second month, on wuzi day, the moon encroached on Tianguan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuzi day, the moon passed through Tianguan.

sentences.zh: 己丑，太陰犯井。

translations.literal: On jichou day, the moon encroached on Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day the moon passed through Jing.

sentences.zh: 給河南、山東貧乏軍士鈔。

translations.literal: Notes were issued to impoverished soldiers in Henan and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Notes were distributed to impoverished soldiers in Henan and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，改軍器局為軍器監。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, the Armaments Bureau was changed to the Armaments Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the Armaments Bureau was renamed the Armaments Directorate.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，百戶渾都速駐營濟南路屬縣三年。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, centurion Qundusu had been encamped in counties subordinate to Jinan Route for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day centurion Qundusu, who had been encamped in Jinan route counties for three years,

sentences.zh: 脅取民飲食糧料當粟五千石，敕杖決之，仍償粟千石。

translations.literal: He had extorted from the people provisions worth five thousand shi of grain; an edict ordered him beaten with the staff, and he was still required to repay one thousand shi of grain.
translations.idiomatic: had extorted from the people provisions worth five thousand shi of grain; an edict ordered him beaten with the staff and still required to repay one thousand shi of grain.

sentences.zh: 析甘州路之肅州自為一路。

translations.literal: Suzhou in Ganzhou Route was split off as its own route.
translations.idiomatic: Ganzhou route's Suzhou was separated as its own route.

sentences.zh: 三月丙寅，罷諸路四品以下子孫入質者。

translations.literal: Third month, on bingyin day, hostages who were descendants of officials below the fourth rank in all routes were released.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingyin day, hostages held from among descendants of officials below fourth rank in all routes were released.

sentences.zh: 田禹妖言，敕減死流之遠方。

translations.literal: Tian Yu spread heterodox talk; an edict commuted his death sentence to exile to a distant place.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Yu spread seditious talk; an edict reduced his death sentence to exile to a distant region.

sentences.zh: 禁民間兵器，犯者驗多寡定罪。

translations.literal: Private weapons among the people were forbidden; offenders were sentenced according to the quantity found.
translations.idiomatic: Private arms among the people were forbidden; offenders were sentenced according to the number seized.

sentences.zh: 甲子，敕怯綿率兵二千招諭建都。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, an edict ordered Qiemian to lead two thousand troops to summon and persuade Jiandu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day an edict ordered Qiemian to lead two thousand troops to summon and persuade Jiandu.

sentences.zh: 壬申，改毋章德山為定遠城，武群山為武勝軍。

translations.literal: On renshen day, Wuzhangdeshan was renamed Dingyuan Fortress, and Wuqunshan was renamed Wusheng Army.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Wuzhangdeshan was renamed Dingyuan Fortress and Wuqunshan Wusheng Army.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，敕阿裏等詣軍前閱視軍籍。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, an edict ordered Ali and others to go to the front to inspect the military registers.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict ordered Ali and others to the front to inspect the military rolls.

sentences.zh: 罷諸路女直、契丹、漢人為達魯花赤者，回回、畏兀、乃蠻、唐兀人仍舊。

translations.literal: Jurchen, Khitan, and Han darughachi in all routes were removed; Muslim, Uyghur, Naiman, and Tangut appointees remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: Jurchen, Khitan, and Han route overseers in all circuits were removed; Muslim, Uyghur, Naiman, and Tangut appointees stayed in place.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬寅，遣使祀嶽瀆。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on renyin day, envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on renyin day, envoys were sent to sacrifice to the mountains and rivers.

sentences.zh: 五月辛亥朔，以太醫院、拱衛司、教坊司及尚食、尚果、尚醞三局隸宣徽院。

translations.literal: Fifth month, first day on xinhai, the Imperial Medical Academy, Archery Guard Office, Music Office, and the Food, Fruit, and Wine bureaus were placed under the Privy Office of the Imperial Household.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai new moon of the fifth month, the Imperial Medical Academy, Archery Guard Office, Music Office, and the Food, Fruit, and Wine bureaus were placed under the Privy Office of the Imperial Household.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，都元帥百家奴拔宋嘉定五花、石城、白馬三寨。

translations.literal: On guihai day, Grand Marshal Baiyanu captured the three Song garrisons of Wuhua, Shicheng, and Baima at Jiading.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Grand Marshal Baiyanu took the three Song strongholds of Wuhua, Shicheng, and Baima at Jiading.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，賜諸王禾忽及八剌合幣帛六萬匹。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, sixty thousand bolts of silk currency were granted to Princes Hehu and Balaqai.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Princes Hehu and Balaqai received sixty thousand bolts of silk currency.

sentences.zh: 六月辛巳朔，濟南王保和以妖言惑眾，謀作亂，敕誅首惡五人，余勿論。

translations.literal: Sixth month, first day on xinsi, Wang Baohe of Jinan deluded the masses with heterodox talk and plotted rebellion; an edict executed the five ringleaders and took no further action against the rest.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi new moon of the sixth month, Wang Baohe of Jinan deluded the people with seditious talk and plotted rebellion; an edict executed the five ringleaders and took no further action against the rest.

sentences.zh: 甲申，中山大雨雹。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, Zhongshan had a great hailstorm.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Zhongshan suffered a major hailstorm.

sentences.zh: 阿術言：「所領者蒙古軍，若遇山水寨柵，非漢軍不可。

translations.literal: Aju said: "The troops I command are Mongol; when encountering mountain-and-water stockades, Han troops are indispensable.
translations.idiomatic: Aju said, "The force I command is Mongol; in mountain-and-water stockades Han troops are indispensable.

sentences.zh: 宜令史樞率漢軍協力征進。

translations.literal: Shi Shu should be ordered to lead Han troops to join forces and advance the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Shu should be ordered to lead Han troops in joint advance.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 戊申，東平等處蝗。

translations.literal: On wushen day, locusts afflicted Dongping and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day locusts struck Dongping and other places.

sentences.zh: 己酉，封諸王習列吉為河平王，賜駝鈕金印。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, Prince Xilieji was enfeoffed as Prince of Heeping and granted a gold seal with a camel knob.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Prince Xilieji was made Prince of Heeping and given a gold seal with a camel knob.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，召翰林直學士高鳴，順州知州劉瑜，中都郝謙、李天輔、韓彥文、李祐赴上都，以山東統軍副使王仲仁戍眉州。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinhai day, Hanlin Attending Academician Gao Ming, Shunzhou Prefect Liu Yu, and the Zhongdu scholars Hao Qian, Li Tianfu, Han Yanwen, and Li You were summoned to Shangdu; Shandong Deputy Army Commander Wang Zhongren was assigned to garrison Meizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinhai day, Gao Ming, Hanlin attending academician; Liu Yu, prefect of Shunzhou; and the Zhongdu scholars Hao Qian, Li Tianfu, Han Yanwen, and Li You were summoned to Shangdu; Shandong deputy army commander Wang Zhongren was posted to garrison Meizhou.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔陜西統軍司兼領軍民錢谷。

translations.literal: On renzi day, an edict ordered the Shaanxi Army Command also to oversee military and civilian revenue and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day an edict put the Shaanxi army command in charge of military and civilian revenues and grain as well.

sentences.zh: 罷各路奧魯官，令管民官兼領。

translations.literal: Auruq officials in all circuits were abolished; civilian administrators were ordered to assume their duties.
translations.idiomatic: Auruq officials in all circuits were abolished, and civilian administrators were ordered to take over their duties.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，立御史臺，以右丞相塔察兒為御史大夫，詔諭之曰：「臺官職在直言，朕或有未當，其極言無隱，毋憚他人，朕當爾主。

translations.literal: On guichou day, the Censorate was established, with Right Grand Councillor Tachar as Censor-in-Chief; an edict instructed him: "The duty of censorial officials is forthright speech. If I am ever in error, speak without reserve and fear no one—I will be your patron.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the Censorate was established, with Right Grand Councillor Tachar as censor-in-chief; an edict told him, "Censorial officials exist to speak plainly. If I am wrong, speak without reserve and fear no one—I will stand behind you.

sentences.zh: 」仍以詔諭天下。

translations.literal: The instruction was also promulgated to the realm by edict.
translations.idiomatic: The same message was promulgated to the realm by edict.

sentences.zh: 立高州北二驛。

translations.literal: Two postal stations north of Gaozhou were established.
translations.idiomatic: Two relay stations north of Gaozhou were established.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，罷西夏宣撫司。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, the Xixia Pacification Commission was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the Xixia pacification commission was abolished.

sentences.zh: 庚午，省諸路打捕鷹坊工匠洞冶總管府，令轉運司兼領之。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, the route-level directorates of hunting, hawking, workshops, and mining were abolished; transport offices were ordered to assume oversight.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day route-level directorates for hunting, hawking, crafts, and mining were abolished, and transport offices were ordered to take them over.

sentences.zh: 丙子，立西夏惠民局。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, a Public Benevolence Bureau was established in Xixia.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day a public-benefit medicine bureau was established in Xixia.

sentences.zh: 高麗國王王禃遣其臣崔東秀來言備兵一萬，造船千隻。

translations.literal: King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent his minister Cui Dongxiu to report that ten thousand troops were being prepared and one thousand ships built.
translations.idiomatic: King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent his minister Cui Dongxiu to report preparations of ten thousand troops and one thousand ships.

sentences.zh: 詔遣都統領脫朵兒往閱之，就相視黑山日本道路，仍命耽羅別造船百艘以伺調用。

translations.literal: An edict sent Commander-in-Chief Tuoduo'er to inspect them, and while there to survey the Black Mountain route to Japan; Tamna was also ordered to build separately one hundred ships for deployment when needed.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent commander-in-chief Tuoduo'er to inspect them and survey the Black Mountain route to Japan; Tamna was also ordered to build a separate hundred ships for deployment when needed.

sentences.zh: 詔四川行省賽典赤自利州還京兆，立東西二川統軍司，以劉整為都元帥，與都元帥阿術同議軍事。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Saiyid Ajall of the Sichuan Branch Secretariat to return from Lizhou to Jingzhao; Eastern and Western Chuan army commands were established, with Liu Zheng as Grand Marshal to deliberate on military affairs jointly with Grand Marshal Aju.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Saiyid Ajall of the Sichuan branch secretariat to return from Lizhou to Jingzhao; eastern and western Chuan army commands were established, with Liu Zheng as grand marshal to consult on military affairs jointly with Grand Marshal Aju.

sentences.zh: 整至軍中，議築白河口、鹿門山，遣使以聞，許之。

translations.literal: When Liu Zheng reached the army, he proposed building fortifications at Baihekou and Lumen Mountain; he sent envoys to report, and approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Zheng reached the army he proposed fortifications at Baihekou and Lumen Mountain, reported by envoy, and approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 罷軍中諸司參議。

translations.literal: Military advisory posts in the armies were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Advisory posts attached to field armies were abolished.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，程思彬以投匿名書言斥乘輿，伏誅。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on yiyou day, Cheng Sibin was executed for submitting an anonymous letter that reviled the imperial carriage.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yiyou day, Cheng Sibin was executed for submitting an anonymous letter reviling the emperor's person.

sentences.zh: 己丑，亳州大水。

translations.literal: On jichou day, Bozhou suffered major flooding.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Bozhou suffered major flooding.

sentences.zh: 庚子，敕京師瀕河立十倉。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, an edict ordered ten granaries built along the river at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day an edict ordered ten granaries built along the river at the capital.

sentences.zh: 命忙古帶率兵六千征西番、建都。

translations.literal: Mangudai was ordered to lead six thousand troops to campaign against Xifan and Jiandu.
translations.idiomatic: Mangudai was ordered to lead six thousand troops against Xifan and Jiandu.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，中都路水，免今年田租。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on guichou day, Zhongdu Route was flooded; this year's land tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guichou day, Zhongdu route was flooded; this year's land tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 罷中都路和顧所。

translations.literal: The Zhongdu Route labor-requisition office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhongdu route labor-requisition office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，阿術統兵圍樊城。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, Aju commanded troops to besiege Fancheng.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Aju besieged Fancheng.

sentences.zh: 敕長春宮修設金箓周天大醮七晝夜。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Changchun Palace to conduct a seven-day-and-night Golden Register grand cosmic jiao ritual.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Changchun Palace to hold a seven-day-and-night Golden Register grand cosmic jiao.

sentences.zh: 建堯廟及后土太寧宮。

translations.literal: A temple to Yao and the Houtu Taining Palace were built.
translations.idiomatic: A temple to Yao and the Houtu Taining Palace were built.

sentences.zh: 庚申，賜安南國王陳光丙錦繡，及其諸臣有差。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, brocades were granted to King Chen Guangbing of Annam, and his ministers in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day brocades were granted to King Chen Guangbing of Annam and his ministers in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 己丑，立河南屯田。

translations.literal: On jichou day, Henan garrison farming was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Henan garrison farming was established.

sentences.zh: 命兵部侍郎黑的、禮部侍郎殷弘賫國書復使日本，仍詔高麗國遣人導送，期於必達，毋致如前稽阻。

translations.literal: Hei'de, Vice Minister of War, and Yin Hong, Vice Minister of Rites, were ordered to carry the state letter on another mission to Japan; Goryeo was also instructed to provide guides and escort, with the goal of certain arrival and no repeat of the previous delays.
translations.idiomatic: Hei'de, vice minister of war, and Yin Hong, vice minister of rites, were ordered to carry the state letter on another mission to Japan; Goryeo was also told to provide guides and escort, with certain arrival expected and no repeat of previous delays.

sentences.zh: 詔諭安南國陳光丙：「來奏稱占城、真臘二寇侵擾，已命卿調兵與不幹並力征討，今復命雲南王忽哥赤統兵南下，卿可遵前詔，遇有叛亂不庭為邊寇者，發兵一同進討，降服者善為撫綏。

translations.literal: An edict addressed Chen Guangbing of Annam: "Your memorial states that Champa and Chenla are raiding; you have already been ordered to mobilize troops and join Bugan in concerted suppression; now Prince Hugachi of Yunnan is further ordered to lead troops south. Follow the earlier edict: wherever rebels refuse allegiance and become border raiders, send troops to advance together; treat those who submit with good governance.
translations.idiomatic: An edict to Chen Guangbing of Annam read, "Your memorial reports raids by Champa and Chenla; you have already been ordered to mobilize and join Bugan in joint suppression; Prince Hugachi of Yunnan is now further ordered south with troops. Follow the earlier edict: wherever rebels refuse allegiance and become border raiders, send troops together; treat those who submit with good governance.

sentences.zh: 」車駕至自上都。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 益都路饑，以米三十一萬八千石賑之。

translations.literal: Yidu Route suffered famine; three hundred eighteen thousand shi of rice were distributed in relief.
translations.idiomatic: Yidu route suffered famine; three hundred eighteen thousand shi of rice were distributed in relief.

sentences.zh: 復以史天澤為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Shi Tianze was again appointed Vice Director of the Military Council.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Tianze was again made vice director of the Military Council.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, first day on wuyin; there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin new moon of the tenth month of winter, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己卯，敕中書省、樞密院，凡有事與御史臺官同奏。

translations.literal: On jimao day, an edict ordered the Central Secretariat and Military Council to present all business jointly with censorial officials.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day an edict ordered the Central Secretariat and Military Council to present all business jointly with censorial officials.

sentences.zh: 立河南等路行中書省，以參知政事阿裏行中書省事。

translations.literal: A branch secretariat for Henan and other routes was established, with Vice Grand Councillor Ali administering branch secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: A branch secretariat for Henan and other routes was established, with Vice Grand Councillor Ali to run branch secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以御史中丞阿裏為參知政事。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, Censor Vice-in-Chief Ali was appointed Vice Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Censor Vice-in-Chief Ali was made vice grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔恤沿邊諸軍，其橫科差賦，責奧魯官償之。

translations.literal: On renwu day, an edict showed concern for frontier armies; irregular extra levies were charged to auruq officials for reimbursement.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict extended relief to frontier armies; irregular extra levies were charged to auruq officials for reimbursement.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，敕從臣禿忽思等錄《毛詩》、《孟子》、《論語》。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, an edict ordered the attendant minister Tuhusi and others to compile editions of the Book of Odes, Mencius, and Analects.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day an edict ordered attendant minister Tuhusi and others to compile the Book of Odes, Mencius, and Analects.

sentences.zh: 乙未，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣言：「前代朝廷必有起居註，故善政嘉謨不致遺失。

translations.literal: Central Secretariat officials said: "Past dynasties always kept daily records, so worthy policies and fine counsels were not lost.
translations.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials said, "Past courts always kept daily records, so worthy policies and fine counsels were not lost.

sentences.zh: 」即以和禮霍孫、獨胡剌充翰林待制兼起居註。

translations.literal: He Lihesun and Duhula were thereupon appointed Hanlin Attending Academicians concurrently as recorders of daily events.
translations.idiomatic: He Lihesun and Duhula were thereupon made Hanlin attending academicians concurrently as recorders of daily events.

sentences.zh: 敕給黎、雅、嘉定新附民田。

translations.literal: An edict granted farmland to newly submitted people of Li, Ya, and Jiading.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted farmland to newly submitted people of Li, Ya, and Jiading.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，宮城成。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, the palace city was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the palace city was completed.

sentences.zh: 劉秉忠辭領中書省事，許之，為太保如故。

translations.literal: Liu Bingzhong resigned his charge of Central Secretariat affairs; permission was granted, and he remained Grand Preceptor as before.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Bingzhong resigned charge of Central Secretariat affairs; permission was granted, and he remained grand preceptor as before.

sentences.zh: 十一月己酉，簽河南、山東邊城附籍諸色戶充軍。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jiyou day, registered households of various categories along the Henan and Shandong border fortifications were drafted as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiyou day, registered households of various categories along the Henan and Shandong border fortifications were drafted as soldiers.

sentences.zh: 庚申，宋兵自襄陽來攻沿山諸寨，阿術分諸軍禦之，斬獲甚眾，立功將士千三百四人。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, Song troops from Xiangyang attacked the mountain garrisons; Aju divided his forces to resist, killing and capturing many; one thousand three hundred four officers and soldiers won merit.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Song troops from Xiangyang attacked the mountain garrisons; Aju divided his forces to resist, killing and capturing many; one thousand three hundred four officers and soldiers won merit.

sentences.zh: 詔首立戰功生擒敵軍者，各賞銀五十兩，其餘賞賚有差。

translations.literal: An edict granted fifty taels of silver each to those who first established battle merit by capturing enemy troops alive; other rewards varied.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted fifty taels of silver each to those who first won battle merit by capturing enemy troops alive; other rewards varied.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，御史臺臣言：「立臺數月，發擿甚多，追理侵欺糧粟近二十萬石，錢物稱是。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Censorate officials reported: "Since establishment several months ago, many cases have been exposed; nearly two hundred thousand shi of misappropriated grain have been recovered, with money and goods in proportion.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day censorate officials reported, "In the few months since establishment many cases have been exposed; nearly two hundred thousand shi of misappropriated grain have been recovered, with money and goods in proportion.

sentences.zh: 」有詔褒諭。

translations.literal: An edict praised and commended them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised and commended them.

sentences.zh: 免南京、河南兩路來歲修築都城役夫。

translations.literal: Laborers for next year's capital construction from Nanjing and Henan routes were exempted.
translations.idiomatic: Laborers for next year's capital construction from Nanjing and Henan routes were exempted.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅，以中都、濟南、益都、淄萊、河間、東平、南京、順天、順德、真定、恩州、高唐、濟州、北京等處大水，免今年田租。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on wuyin day, because of major floods at Zhongdu, Jinan, Yidu, Zilai, Hejian, Dongping, Nanjing, Shuntian, Shunde, Zhending, Enzhou, Gaotang, Jizhou, Beiping and other places, this year's land tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuyin day, because of major floods at Zhongdu, Jinan, Yidu, Zilai, Hejian, Dongping, Nanjing, Shuntian, Shunde, Zhending, Enzhou, Gaotang, Jizhou, Beiping, and other places, this year's land tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 敕二分、二至及聖誕節日，祭星於司天臺。

translations.literal: An edict ordered star sacrifices at the Astronomical Bureau on the equinoxes, solstices, and the emperor's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered star sacrifices at the Astronomical Bureau on the equinoxes, solstices, and the emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 詔諭四川行省沿邊屯戍軍士逃役者處死。

translations.literal: An edict informed the Sichuan Branch Secretariat that border garrison soldiers who deserted would be executed.
translations.idiomatic: An edict told the Sichuan branch secretariat that border garrison soldiers who deserted would be executed.

sentences.zh: 復置乾州奉天縣，省好畤、永壽入焉。

translations.literal: Fengtian County in Qianzhou was reestablished; Haochi and Yongshou were abolished and incorporated into it.
translations.idiomatic: Fengtian County in Qianzhou was reestablished; Haochi and Yongshou were abolished and absorbed into it.

sentences.zh: 以鳳州隸興元路；

translations.literal: Fengzhou was placed under Xingyuan Route;
translations.idiomatic: Fengzhou was placed under Xingyuan route;

sentences.zh: 德興府改奉聖州，隸宣德。

translations.literal: Dexing Prefecture was renamed Fengsheng Prefecture and placed under Xuande.
translations.idiomatic: Dexing Prefecture was renamed Fengsheng Prefecture and placed under Xuande.

sentences.zh: 是歲，京兆大旱。

translations.literal: That year, Jingzhao suffered severe drought.
translations.idiomatic: That year Jingzhao suffered severe drought.

sentences.zh: 天下戶一百六十五萬二百八十六，斷死罪六十九人。

translations.literal: Households under heaven numbered 1,650,286; sixty-nine persons were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: Households under heaven numbered 1,650,286; sixty-nine persons were sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王金、銀、幣、帛如歲例。

translations.literal: Gold, silver, silk currency, and cloth were granted to the princes according to the annual precedent.
translations.idiomatic: The princes received gold, silver, silk currency, and cloth according to annual custom.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月癸丑，高麗國王王禃遣使以誅權臣金俊來告，賜歷日、西錦。

translations.literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, on guichou day, King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent envoys to report the execution of the powerful minister Jin Jun; a calendar and western brocade were granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on guichou day in the first month of spring, King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent envoys reporting the execution of the powerful minister Jin Jun; a calendar and western brocade were granted.

sentences.zh: 立四道按察司。

translations.literal: Four branch surveillance commissions were established.
translations.idiomatic: Four branch surveillance commissions were established.

sentences.zh: 戊午，阿術軍入宋境，至復州、德安府、荊山等處，俘萬人而還。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, Aju's army entered Song territory, reaching Fuzhou, De'an Prefecture, Jingshan and other places, captured ten thousand persons, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Aju's army entered Song territory, reaching Fuzhou, De'an Prefecture, Jingshan, and other places, captured ten thousand people, and returned.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以參知政事楊果為懷孟路總管。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, Vice Grand Councillor Yang Guo was appointed Route-intendant of Huaimeng.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Vice Grand Councillor Yang Guo was made intendant of Huaimeng route.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，益都、淄萊大水，恩州饑，命賑之。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, Yidu and Zilai had major floods; Enzhou suffered famine; relief was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Yidu and Zilai suffered major floods and Enzhou famine; relief was ordered.

sentences.zh: 敕史天澤與樞密副使駙馬忽剌出董師襄陽。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Shi Tianze and Vice Director of the Military Council, the imperial son-in-law Qara Qush, to oversee the army at Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Shi Tianze and the imperial son-in-law Qara Qush, vice director of the Military Council, to oversee the army at Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 二月壬午，以立四道提刑按察司詔諭諸道。

translations.literal: Second month, on renwu day, an edict was issued to all circuits concerning the establishment of four branch offices for criminal investigation and surveillance.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renwu day, an edict was issued to all circuits concerning the establishment of four branch offices for criminal investigation and surveillance.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔以新制蒙古字頒行天下。

translations.literal: On jichou day, an edict ordered the newly devised Mongol script promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day an edict ordered the newly devised Mongol script promulgated throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 丙申，罷宣德府稅課所，以上都轉運司兼領。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, the tax-collection office of Xuande Prefecture was abolished, and the Shangdu Transport Commission was made to administer it concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the Xuande tax office was abolished and its duties assigned to the Shangdu transport commission.

sentences.zh: 改河南、懷孟、順德三路稅課所為轉運司。

translations.literal: The tax-collection offices of the Henan, Huaimeng, and Shunde routes were converted into Transport Commissions.
translations.idiomatic: Tax offices in the Henan, Huaimeng, and Shunde routes were converted into transport commissions.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，簽民兵二萬赴襄陽。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, twenty thousand conscripted militia were sent to Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day twenty thousand conscripted militia were sent to Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 賑欠州人匠貧乏者米五千九百九十九石。

translations.literal: Relief grain of five thousand nine hundred ninety-nine shi was issued to impoverished artisan households in Qian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Five thousand nine hundred ninety-nine shi of relief grain was issued to impoverished artisan households in Qian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 敕：「鞍、靴、箭鏃等物，自今不得以黃金為飾。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Henceforth saddles, boots, arrowheads, and the like may not be decorated with gold.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared that saddles, boots, arrowheads, and similar items could no longer be decorated with gold.

sentences.zh: 」開元等路饑，減戶賦布二匹，秋稅減其半，水達達戶減青鼠二，其租稅被災者免征。

translations.literal: Kaiyuan and other routes suffered famine; household cloth levies were reduced by two bolts, autumn taxes cut by half, Udege households had their sable levy reduced by two, and rents and taxes in disaster areas were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaiyuan and other famine-stricken routes household cloth levies were cut by two bolts, autumn taxes halved, the sable levy on Udege households reduced by two, and disaster-area rents and taxes remitted.

sentences.zh: 免單丁貧乏軍士一千九百餘戶為民。

translations.literal: One thousand nine hundred-odd households of impoverished sole surviving soldiers were released to become civilians.
translations.idiomatic: More than nineteen hundred households of impoverished sole surviving soldiers were released to civilian status.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，給河南行省鈔千錠犒軍。

translations.literal: On guimao day, one thousand ingots of paper notes were issued to the Henan Branch Secretariat to reward the army.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day one thousand ingots of paper notes were sent to the Henan branch secretariat to reward the troops.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，詔益都路簽軍萬人，人給鈔二十五貫。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiayin day, an edict ordered Yidu Route to conscript ten thousand troops, each man given twenty-five strings of paper notes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day of the third month an edict ordered Yidu to conscript ten thousand troops, each man receiving twenty-five strings of notes.

sentences.zh: 戊午，賑曹州饑。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, Cao Prefecture's famine was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day relief was issued for the famine in Cao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 築堡鹿門山。

translations.literal: A fortress was built at Lumen Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: A fortress was built at Lumen Mountain.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛巳，制玉璽大小十紐。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on xinsi day, ten jade seals large and small were made.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day in the fourth month of summer ten jade seals, large and small, were made.

sentences.zh: 甲午，遣使祀嶽瀆。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day envoys were sent to sacrifice at the sacred mountains and rivers.

sentences.zh: 大名等路饑，賑米十萬石。

translations.literal: Daming and other routes suffered famine; one hundred thousand shi of rice was issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Daming and other routes suffered famine; one hundred thousand shi of rice was issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午，東平路饑，賑米四萬一千三百餘石。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on bingwu day, Dongping Route suffered famine; forty-one thousand three hundred-odd shi of rice was issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day of the fifth month Dongping suffered famine; more than forty-one thousand three hundred shi of rice was issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔禁戍邊軍士牧踐屯田禾稼。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, an edict forbade frontier garrison soldiers from pasturing livestock on garrison-farm grain crops.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day an edict forbade frontier garrison troops from grazing livestock on garrison-farm crops.

sentences.zh: 六月辛巳，以招討怯綿征建都敗績，又擅追唆火兒璽書、金符，處死。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on xinsi day, because Pacification Commissioner Qiemian's campaign against Jiandu had failed and he had also on his own authority recalled Suohuo'er's imperial patent and gold tally, he was put to death.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day of the sixth month Qiemian, pacification commissioner against Jiandu, was executed for his defeat and for having on his own authority recalled Suohuo'er's imperial patent and gold tally.

sentences.zh: 壬午，免益都新簽軍單丁者千六百二十一人為民。

translations.literal: On renwu day, one thousand six hundred twenty-one sole surviving men among newly conscripted troops in Yidu were released to become civilians.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day one thousand six hundred twenty-one sole surviving men among Yidu's newly conscripted troops were released to civilian status.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，河南、河北、山東諸郡蝗。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, locusts struck the prefectures of Henan, Hebei, and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day locusts struck prefectures across Henan, Hebei, and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，敕：「真定等路旱蝗，其代輸築城役夫戶賦悉免之。

translations.literal: On guisi day, an edict stated: "In Zhending and other routes afflicted by drought and locusts, household levies of substitute laborers for wall-building corvée are all remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day an edict remitted household levies for substitute wall-building laborers in drought- and locust-stricken Zhending and other routes.

sentences.zh: 」丙申，高麗國王王禃遣其世子愖來朝，賜禃玉帶一，愖金五十兩，從官銀幣有差。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent his heir Wang Chŏm to court; Wang Chŏn was granted one jade belt, Wang Chŏm fifty taels of gold, and accompanying officials silver and silk in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent Crown Prince Wang Chŏm to court; Wang Chŏn received one jade belt, Wang Chŏm fifty taels of gold, and accompanying officials silver and silk in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，阿術率兵萬五千人厄宋萬山、射垛岡、鬼門關樵蘇之路。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Aju led fifteen thousand troops to block the firewood-gathering routes at Song's Wanshan, Sheduo Ridge, and Guimen Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Aju led fifteen thousand men to cut off Song firewood routes at Wanshan, Sheduo Ridge, and Guimen Pass.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔董文炳等率兵二萬二千人南征。

translations.literal: On guimao day, an edict ordered Dong Wenbing and others to lead twenty-two thousand troops south on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day an edict ordered Dong Wenbing and others to lead twenty-two thousand troops south on campaign.

sentences.zh: 東昌路饑，賑米二萬七千五百九十石。

translations.literal: Dongchang Route suffered famine; twenty-seven thousand five hundred ninety shi of rice was issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Dongchang suffered famine; twenty-seven thousand five hundred ninety shi of rice was issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁巳，遣宋私商四十五人還其國。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingsi day, forty-five private Song merchants were sent back to their country.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day in the seventh month of autumn forty-five private Song merchants were sent home.

sentences.zh: 庚申，水軍千戶邢德立、張誌等生擒宋荊鄂都統唐永堅，賞銀幣有差。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, naval wanhu Xing Deli, Zhang Zhi, and others captured alive Song Jing-E Commander-in-Chief Tang Yongjian; silver and silk rewards were granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day naval wanhu Xing Deli, Zhang Zhi, and others captured Song Jing-E commander-in-chief Tang Yongjian alive; silver and silk rewards were granted in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，制太常寺祭服。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, sacrificial robes for the Court of Imperial Sacrifices were made.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day sacrificial robes were made for the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，西京大雨雹。

translations.literal: On renxu day, Xijing suffered heavy hail.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Xijing was struck by heavy hail.

sentences.zh: 己巳，立諸路蒙古字學。

translations.literal: On jisi day, Mongol-script schools were established in all routes.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Mongol-script schools were established in every route.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，立國子學。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, the National Academy was established.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the National Academy was established.

sentences.zh: 詔遣官審理諸路冤滯，正犯死罪明白者，各正典刑，其雜犯死罪以下量斷遣之。

translations.literal: An edict dispatched officials to review wrongful detentions in all routes; where capital crimes were clearly proven, each was punished according to law; other cases from capital crimes downward were adjudicated and dispatched as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent officials to review wrongful detentions in all routes; proven capital offenders were punished by law, and lesser cases were adjudicated and disposed of as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 又詔諭宋國官吏軍民，示以不欲用兵之意。

translations.literal: Another edict addressed Song officials, soldiers, and civilians, making known the wish not to use force.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict addressed Song officials, soldiers, and civilians, stating the court's wish to avoid war.

sentences.zh: 復遣都統領脫朵兒、統領王國昌等往高麗點閱所備兵船，及相視耽羅等處道路。

translations.literal: Commanders-in-Chief Todaiur and Commander Wang Guochang and others were again sent to Goryeo to inspect the prepared warships and survey the roads to Tamna and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Commander-in-chief Todaiur, commander Wang Guochang, and others were again sent to Goryeo to inspect prepared warships and survey routes to Tamna and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 立西蜀四川監榷茶場使司。

translations.literal: The Western Sichuan Tea Monopoly Superintendency of Sichuan was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Sichuan tea monopoly superintendency was established in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 宋將夏貴率兵船三千至鹿門山，萬戶解汝楫、李庭率舟師敗之，俘殺二千餘人，獲戰艦五十艘。

translations.literal: Song General Xia Gui led three thousand warships to Lumen Mountain; wanhu Jie Ruji and Li Ting led the fleet to defeat them, capturing and killing more than two thousand men and seizing fifty warships.
translations.idiomatic: Song general Xia Gui brought three thousand warships to Lumen Mountain; wanhu Jie Ruji and Li Ting led the fleet to defeat them, killing or capturing more than two thousand men and seizing fifty warships.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯，立金州招討司。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jimao day, the Jin Prefecture Pacification Commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day of the eighth month the Jin Prefecture pacification commission was established.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以沙、肅州鈔法未行，降詔諭之。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, because the paper-currency system had not yet been implemented in Sha and Suzhou, an edict was issued to instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, because paper currency had not yet been implemented in Sha and Suzhou, an edict was issued to instruct them.

sentences.zh: 詔諸路勸課農桑。

translations.literal: An edict ordered all routes to encourage farming and sericulture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered every route to encourage farming and sericulture.

sentences.zh: 命中書省采農桑事，列為條目，仍令提刑按察司與州縣官相風土之所宜，講究可否，別頒行之。

translations.literal: The Central Secretariat was ordered to collect matters of farming and sericulture, set them out in articles, and further instruct the Surveillance and Investigation Commissions together with prefecture and county officials to consider what suited local conditions, study what was feasible, and issue separate regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The Central Secretariat was ordered to compile farming and sericulture regulations and have surveillance commissions work with prefecture and county officials to adapt them to local conditions, study feasibility, and issue separate rules.

sentences.zh: 高麗國世子愖奏，其國臣僚擅廢國王王禃，立其弟安慶公淐。

translations.literal: Goryeo Crown Prince Wang Chŏm memorialized that his country's officials had on their own authority deposed King Wang Chŏn and enthroned his younger brother, Prince of Anqing Wang Chŏ.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo crown prince Wang Chŏm reported that his country's officials had deposed King Wang Chŏn on their own authority and enthroned his younger brother, Prince of Anqing Wang Chŏ.

sentences.zh: 詔遣斡朵思不花、李諤等往其國詳問，條具以聞。

translations.literal: An edict dispatched Odoci Buga, Li E, and others to go to that country for detailed inquiry and report item by item.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent Odoci Buga, Li E, and others to Goryeo for a detailed inquiry and itemized report.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，恩州進嘉禾，一莖三穗。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on guichou day, En Prefecture presented auspicious grain with one stalk and three ears.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day of the ninth month En Prefecture presented auspicious grain with one stalk bearing three ears.

sentences.zh: 戊午，敕民間貸錢取息，雖逾限止償一本息。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, an edict stated that private moneylending at interest, even when past the limit, required repayment of only principal plus one period's interest.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day an edict ruled that private loans at interest, even when overdue, required repayment of only principal plus one period's interest.

sentences.zh: 己未，授高麗世子王愖特進上柱國、東安公。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, Goryeo Crown Prince Wang Chŏm was granted the extraordinary rank of Superior Pillar of State and made Duke of Dong'an.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Goryeo crown prince Wang Chŏm was granted the extraordinary rank of superior pillar of state and made Duke of Dong'an.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，豐州、雲內、東勝旱，免其租賦。

translations.literal: On renxu day, Feng, Yunnei, and Dongsheng suffered drought; their rents and levies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day drought struck Feng, Yunnei, and Dongsheng; their rents and levies were remitted.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，敕高麗世子愖率兵三千赴其國難，愖辭東安公，乃授特進上柱國。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, an edict ordered Goryeo Crown Prince Chŏm to lead three thousand troops to his country's crisis; Chŏm declined the title Duke of Dong'an, and was then granted only the extraordinary rank of Superior Pillar of State.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day an edict ordered Goryeo crown prince Chŏm to lead three thousand troops to his country's crisis; Chŏm declined the title Duke of Dong'an and received only the extraordinary rank of superior pillar of state.

sentences.zh: 辛未，敕管軍萬戶宋仲義征高麗。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, an edict ordered army-controlling wanhu Song Zhongyi to campaign against Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day an edict ordered army-controlling wanhu Song Zhongyi to campaign against Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 以忽剌出、史天澤並平章政事，阿里中書右丞，行河南等路中書省事，賽典赤行陜西五路西蜀四川中書省事。

translations.literal: Huarchu and Shi Tianze were both made Grand Councillors; Ali was made Right Vice Director of the Central Secretariat and administered Branch Secretariat affairs for Henan and other routes; Sayyid Ajall administered Branch Secretariat affairs for the Shaanxi Five Routes, Western Shu, and Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Huarchu and Shi Tianze were both made grand councillors; Ali was made right vice director of the Central Secretariat and placed in charge of the Henan branch secretariat; Sayyid Ajall took charge of the Shaanxi Five Routes, Western Shu, and Sichuan branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 車駕至自上都。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 斡朵思不花、李諤以高麗刑部尚書金方慶至，奉權國王淐表，訴國王禃遘疾，令弟淐權國事。

translations.literal: Odoci Buga and Li E, with Goryeo Minister of Justice Kim Pang-gyeong having arrived, presented a memorial from Acting King Wang Chŏ, stating that King Wang Chŏn had fallen gravely ill and had entrusted state affairs to his brother Chŏ.
translations.idiomatic: Odoci Buga and Li E, with Goryeo minister of justice Kim Pang-gyeong in attendance, presented a memorial from acting king Wang Chŏ claiming that King Wang Chŏn had fallen gravely ill and entrusted affairs of state to his brother Chŏ.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，定朝儀服色。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jimao day, court ceremonial colors were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day in the tenth month of winter court ceremonial colors were fixed.

sentences.zh: 壬午，升高唐、冠氏並為州。

translations.literal: On renwu day, Gaotang and Guanshi were both promoted to prefecture status.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Gaotang and Guanshi were both promoted to prefecture status.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，廣平路旱，免租賦。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, Guangping Route suffered drought; rents and levies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Guangping suffered drought; rents and levies were remitted.

sentences.zh: 詔遣兵部侍郎黑的、淄萊路總管府判官徐世雄，召高麗國王王禃、王弟淐及權臣林衍俱赴闕。

translations.literal: An edict dispatched Vice Minister of War Qara, Guangping Route chief secretary Xu Shixiong, to summon King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo, his brother Wang Chŏ, and powerful minister Lin Yan all to court.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent vice minister of war Qara and Guangping route chief secretary Xu Shixiong to summon King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo, his brother Wang Chŏ, and powerful minister Lin Yan to court.

sentences.zh: 命國王頭輦哥以兵壓其境，趙璧行中書省於東京，仍降詔諭高麗國軍民。

translations.literal: Prince Touliangge was ordered to press the border with troops; Zhao Bi administered the Branch Secretariat at Dongjing; an edict was also issued to address the soldiers and people of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Touliangge was ordered to press Goryeo's border with troops; Zhao Bi ran the branch secretariat at Dongjing; and an edict was issued to Goryeo's soldiers and people.

sentences.zh: 庚子，太陰犯辰星。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, the moon infringed upon Mercury.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day the moon infringed upon Mercury.

sentences.zh: 宋遣人饋鹽、糧入襄陽，我軍獲之。

translations.literal: The Song sent men bearing salt and grain into Xiangyang; our army seized them.
translations.idiomatic: The Song sent men bearing salt and grain into Xiangyang; our forces seized the supplies.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王奧魯赤駝鈕金鍍銀印。

translations.literal: Prince Oljei was granted a camel-knob gold-plated silver seal.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Oljei received a camel-knob gold-plated silver seal.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯，高麗都統領崔坦等，以林衍作亂，挈西京五十餘城來附。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on guimao day, Goryeo Commander-in-Chief Choi Tan and others, because Lin Yan had risen in rebellion, brought more than fifty western capital cities to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day of the eleventh month Goryeo commander-in-chief Choi Tan and others, citing Lin Yan's rebellion, brought more than fifty western capital cities over to the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 丁未，簽王綧、洪茶丘軍三千人往定高麗。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, three thousand troops under Wang Zhen and Hong Chagiu were conscripted to pacify Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day three thousand troops under Wang Zhen and Hong Chagiu were conscripted to pacify Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 高麗西京都統李延齡乞益兵，遣忙哥都率兵二千赴之。

translations.literal: Goryeo Western Capital Commander-in-Chief Li Yanling requested additional troops; Mangudai was dispatched with two thousand men to join him.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo western capital commander Li Yanling requested reinforcements; Mangudai was sent with two thousand men to join him.

sentences.zh: 庚午，敕：「諸路鰥寡廢疾之人，月給米二斗。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, an edict stated: "Widowers, widows, orphans, and the disabled in all routes shall receive two dou of rice monthly.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day an edict ordered that widowers, widows, orphans, and the disabled in all routes receive two dou of rice each month.

sentences.zh: 」安南國王陳光丙遣使來貢。

translations.literal: The King of Annam, Chen Guangbing, sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: King Chen Guangbing of Annam sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 濟南饑，以米十二萬八千九百石賑之。

translations.literal: Jinan suffered famine; one hundred twenty-eight thousand nine hundred shi of rice was issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Jinan suffered famine; one hundred twenty-eight thousand nine hundred shi of rice was issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 高麗國王王禃遣其尚書禮部侍郎樸烋從黑的入朝，表稱受詔已復位，尋當入覲。

translations.literal: King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent his Vice Minister of Rites Pak Hyo to enter court with Qara; his memorial stated that on receiving the edict he had already been restored to the throne and would soon come in audience.
translations.idiomatic: King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent vice minister of rites Pak Hyo to court with Qara; his memorial stated that he had already been restored on receiving the edict and would soon come in audience.

sentences.zh: 築新城於漢江西。

translations.literal: A new city was built on the west bank of the Han River.
translations.idiomatic: A new city was built on the west bank of the Han River.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子，築東安渾河堤。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuzi day, the Dong'an Hun River embankment was built.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day of the twelfth month the Dong'an Hun River embankment was built.

sentences.zh: 己丑，作佛事於太廟七晝夜。

translations.literal: On jichou day, Buddhist rites were performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple for seven days and nights.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Buddhist rites were performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple for seven days and nights.

sentences.zh: 高唐、固安二州饑，以米二萬六百石賑之。

translations.literal: Gaotang and Gu'an prefectures suffered famine; twenty thousand six hundred shi of rice was issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Gaotang and Gu'an suffered famine; twenty thousand six hundred shi of rice was issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 析彰德、懷孟、衛輝為三路，升林慮縣為林州，改楨州復為韓城縣，並省馮翊等州縣十所，以懿州、廣寧等府隸東京。

translations.literal: Zhangde, Huaimeng, and Weihui were split into three routes; Linlu County was promoted to Lin Prefecture; Zhen Prefecture was again changed to Hancheng County; ten prefectures and counties including Fengyi were consolidated; and Yizhou, Guangning, and other prefectures were placed under Dongjing.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangde, Huaimeng, and Weihui were split into three routes; Linlu County was promoted to Lin Prefecture; Zhen Prefecture was again made Hancheng County; ten prefectures and counties including Fengyi were consolidated; and Yizhou, Guangning, and other prefectures were placed under Dongjing.

sentences.zh: 是歲，天下戶一百六十八萬四千一百五十七。

translations.literal: That year, registered households empire-wide numbered one million six hundred eighty-four thousand one hundred fifty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: That year registered households empire-wide numbered one million six hundred eighty-four thousand one hundred fifty-seven.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王金、銀、幣、帛如歲例。

translations.literal: Princes were granted gold, silver, silks, and cloth according to the annual precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Princes received gold, silver, silks, and cloth according to the annual precedent.

sentences.zh: 斷死罪四十二人。

translations.literal: Forty-two persons were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: Forty-two persons were sentenced to death.
